281	  # Marks a pending review as approved or amended and posts its journal entry in
282	  # ONE transaction.
283	  #
284	  # The journal entry is created from the decision's effective data (amended data
285	  # when present, original otherwise) in the same transaction that updates the
286	  # review, and carries the source document's fingerprint. A duplicate invoice —
287	  # enforced by the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique
288	  # (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings — rolls the whole
289	  # transition back and the review stays pending. Returns
290	  # `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` in that case, `{:error, changeset}` for other
291	  # failures.
292	  #
293	  # With `confirm_file_reuse: true`, the duplicate check is re-run inside the
294	  # transaction on the effective data. Only a `:file_reuse` verdict marks the
295	  # entry `source_file_reuse_confirmed` and records the confirmation with the
296	  # matched entry IDs in the event log; a blocked verdict is refused as a
297	  # duplicate, and any other verdict as `:file_reuse_not_applicable`, so a
298	  # confirmation is never inferred or applied to the wrong match.
299	  defp post_review_transaction(
300	         decision,
301	         changeset_attrs,
302	         event_type,
303	         event_metadata,
304	         status,
305	         opts
306	       ) do
307	    confirm_file_reuse? = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm_file_reuse, false) == true
308	
309	    booking = Keyword.get(opts, :booking)
310	    tax_claim_attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :tax_claim_attrs, %{})
311	
312	    event_metadata =
313	      if booking,
314	        do: Map.merge(event_metadata, %{booking: booking, tax_claim: tax_claim_attrs}),
315	        else: event_metadata
316	
317	    Multi.new()
318	    |> Multi.run(:source_document_sha256, fn repo, _changes ->
319	      {:ok, source_document_sha256(repo, decision)}
320	    end)
321	    |> Multi.update(
322	      :review_decision,
323	      ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(decision, changeset_attrs)
324	    )
325	    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse, fn _repo, changes ->
326	      file_reuse_confirmation(confirm_file_reuse?, changes)
327	    end)
328	    |> Multi.merge(fn %{review_decision: updated} = changes ->
329	      Accounting.create_multi_from_decision(updated, tax_claim_attrs,
330	        source_document_sha256: changes.source_document_sha256,
331	        source_file_reuse_confirmed: changes.file_reuse != nil,
332	        booking: booking
333	      )
334	    end)
335	    |> Multi.run(:event_log, fn repo, %{review_decision: updated} ->
336	      insert_event_log(
337	        repo,
338	        event_type,
339	        updated.extracted_content_id,
340	        updated.user_id,
341	        event_metadata
342	      )
343	    end)
344	    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse_event_log, fn repo, changes ->
345	      insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, changes)
346	    end)
347	    |> Repo.transaction()
348	    |> case do
349	      {:ok, %{review_decision: updated}} ->
350	        emit_review_completed_event(updated, status)
351	        {:ok, updated}
352	
353	      {:error, :file_reuse, reason, _changes} ->
354	        {:error, reason}
355	
356	      {:error, :journal_entry, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
357	        if Accounting.duplicate_error?(changeset) do
358	          {:error, :duplicate_invoice}
359	        else
360	          {:error, changeset}
361	        end
362	
363	      {:error, _operation, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
364	        {:error, changeset}
365	    end
366	  end
367	
368	  defp file_reuse_confirmation(false, _changes), do: {:ok, nil}
369	
370	  defp file_reuse_confirmation(true, %{
371	         review_decision: updated,
372	         source_document_sha256: source_sha256
373	       }) do
374	    check =
375	      Accounting.duplicate_check(
376	        updated.user_id,
377	        ReviewDecision.effective_data(updated),
378	        source_sha256
379	      )
380	
381	    case check.verdict do
382	      :file_reuse ->
383	        {:ok, %{matched_journal_entry_ids: Enum.map(check.candidates, & &1.entry.id)}}
384	
385	      verdict when verdict in [:invoice_number, :same_file_blocked] ->
386	        {:error, :duplicate_invoice}
387	
388	      _no_file_match ->
389	        {:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}
390	    end
391	  end
392	
393	  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(_repo, %{file_reuse: nil}), do: {:ok, nil}
394	
395	  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, %{
396	         file_reuse: %{matched_journal_entry_ids: [matched_id | _] = matched_ids},
397	         journal_entry: entry,
398	         review_decision: updated
399	       }) do
400	    insert_event_log(
401	      repo,
402	      "source_file_reuse_confirmed",
403	      updated.extracted_content_id,
404	      updated.user_id,
405	      %{
406	        journal_entry_id: entry.id,
407	        matched_journal_entry_id: matched_id,
408	        matched_journal_entry_ids: matched_ids
409	      }
410	    )
411	  end
412	
413	  # Loads the decision's source document fingerprint, scoped to the decision's
414	  # user through both the extraction and the document.
415	  defp source_document_sha256(repo, %ReviewDecision{} = decision) do
416	    from(ec in ExtractedContent,
417	      join: d in Document,
418	      on: d.id == ec.document_id,
419	      where: ec.id == ^decision.extracted_content_id,
420	      where: ec.user_id == ^decision.user_id and d.user_id == ^decision.user_id,
421	      select: d.content_sha256
422	    )
423	    |> repo.one()
424	  end
425	
426	  # Best-effort audit write for transitions that do not post a journal entry.
427	  defp write_event_log(event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
428	    case insert_event_log(Repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
429	      {:ok, _event_log} ->
430	        :ok
431	
432	      {:error, reason} ->
433	        Logger.warning("Failed to write event log for #{event_type}: #{inspect(reason)}")
434	        :ok
435	    end
436	  end
437	
438	  # Inside the posting transaction the audit entry is required: an error
439	  # rolls back the review update and the journal entry with it.
440	  defp insert_event_log(repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
441	    %{
442	      event_type: event_type,
443	      invoice_id: to_string(invoice_id),
444	      user_id: user_id,
445	      metadata: metadata,
446	      status: "completed"
447	    }
448	    |> EventLog.changeset_for_create()
449	    |> repo.insert()
450	  end
451	
452	  defp emit_review_completed_event(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, status) do
453	    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, "invoice_review:completed", %{
454	      invoice_id: decision.extracted_content_id,
455	      status: status,
456	      user_id: decision.user_id,
457	      decision_data: decision.decision_data,
458	      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
459	    })
460	  end
461	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for budget journal entries.
4	
5	  Journal entries are created automatically from approved/amended invoices.
6	  A human assigns a budget category and need/want classification to post each entry.
7	  """
8	
9	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
10	
11	  alias Ecto.Multi
12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
13	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
19	
20	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21	  # Duplicate detection
22	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
23	
24	  @doc """
25	  Returns journal entries already recorded for this user that appear to be the
26	  same invoice as `data` (an `%ExtractedData{}` with the invoice's final,
27	  reviewer-confirmed values).
28	
29	  * With an invoice number, the strong match is (user, issuer, invoice number),
30	    compared case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace trimmed.
31	  * Without a number, a soft match requires the exact tuple (issuer, date,
32	    amount, currency). A missing component never matches.
33	
34	  Candidates from other users are never returned.
35	  """
36	  @spec duplicate_candidates(integer() | nil, ExtractedData.t()) :: [JournalEntry.t()]
37	  def duplicate_candidates(nil, %ExtractedData{}), do: []
38	
39	  def duplicate_candidates(user_id, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
40	    base =
41	      from(je in JournalEntry,
42	        where: je.user_id == ^user_id,
43	        where: fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.issuer, ^data.issuer),
44	        order_by: [desc: je.inserted_at],
45	        limit: 5
46	      )
47	
48	    base
49	    |> candidate_filters(data)
50	    |> Repo.all()
51	  end
52	
53	  @typedoc """
54	  Why a journal entry is a duplicate candidate, strongest first: the same
55	  uploaded file, the same (issuer, invoice number), or the same
56	  (issuer, date, amount, currency) tuple.
57	  """
58	  @type match_reason :: :same_file | :invoice_number | :same_details
59	
60	  @typedoc """
61	  The outcome of `duplicate_check/3`.
62	
63	  * `:none` — no candidate; post freely.
64	  * `:possible` — only a soft (issuer, date, amount, currency) match; posting
65	    needs the existing explicit "post anyway" confirmation.
66	  * `:file_reuse` — the same uploaded file and nothing else matches; posting
67	    needs an explicit file-reuse confirmation (for example, a reused QR-bill).
68	  * `:invoice_number` — the invoice number is already recorded for the issuer;
69	    blocked until the data is amended.
70	  * `:same_file_blocked` — the same uploaded file and the invoice facts also
71	    match; blocked, the review should be rejected.
72	  """
73	  @type verdict :: :none | :possible | :file_reuse | :invoice_number | :same_file_blocked
74	
75	  @type duplicate_check :: %{
76	          verdict: verdict(),
77	          candidates: [%{entry: JournalEntry.t(), reason: match_reason()}]
78	        }
79	
80	  @doc """
81	  Checks `data` (the invoice's final values) and the source document's
82	  fingerprint against the user's journal entries.
83	
84	  Combines `duplicate_candidates/2` with an exact match on
85	  `source_document_sha256`. A candidate matching several rules is listed once
86	  with its strongest reason. An exact-file match is confirmable as a reuse only
87	  when neither field rule matches; the (issuer, date, amount, currency) tuple
88	  is also compared against the file-matched entries even when `data` has an
89	  invoice number, so the same file with the same facts is never confirmable.
90	
91	  A nil fingerprint never matches, and other users' entries are never queried.
92	  """
93	  @spec duplicate_check(integer() | nil, ExtractedData.t(), String.t() | nil) ::
94	          duplicate_check()
95	  def duplicate_check(nil, %ExtractedData{}, _source_sha256),
96	    do: %{verdict: :none, candidates: []}
97	
98	  def duplicate_check(user_id, %ExtractedData{} = data, source_sha256) do
99	    field_matches = duplicate_candidates(user_id, data)
100	    file_matches = file_candidates(user_id, source_sha256)
101	    field_reason = if strong_match?(data, field_matches), do: :invoice_number, else: :same_details
102	
103	    verdict =
104	      cond do
105	        file_matches != [] and
106	            (field_matches != [] or same_details_as_file_match?(user_id, data, file_matches)) ->
107	          :same_file_blocked
108	
109	        file_matches != [] ->
110	          :file_reuse
111	
112	        field_reason == :invoice_number ->
113	          :invoice_number
114	
115	        field_matches != [] ->
116	          :possible
117	
118	        true ->
119	          :none
120	      end
121	
122	    candidates =
123	      Enum.map(file_matches, &%{entry: &1, reason: :same_file}) ++
124	        Enum.map(field_matches, &%{entry: &1, reason: field_reason})
125	
126	    %{verdict: verdict, candidates: Enum.uniq_by(candidates, & &1.entry.id)}
127	  end
128	
129	  @doc "True when a `duplicate_check/3` verdict forbids posting outright."
130	  @spec blocked?(duplicate_check()) :: boolean()
131	  def blocked?(%{verdict: verdict}), do: verdict in [:invoice_number, :same_file_blocked]
132	
133	  defp file_candidates(_user_id, nil), do: []
134	
135	  defp file_candidates(user_id, source_sha256) when is_binary(source_sha256) do
136	    from(je in JournalEntry,
137	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^source_sha256,
138	      order_by: [desc: je.inserted_at, desc: je.id]
139	    )
140	    |> Repo.all()
141	  end
142	
143	  defp same_details_as_file_match?(user_id, data, file_matches) do
144	    ids = Enum.map(file_matches, & &1.id)
145	
146	    from(je in JournalEntry,
147	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.id in ^ids,
148	      where: fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.issuer, ^data.issuer),
149	      select: count(je.id)
150	    )
151	    |> soft_match_filters(data)
152	    |> Repo.one()
153	    |> Kernel.>(0)
154	  end
155	
156	  # Numbered and unnumbered matches are mutually exclusive: a nonblank invoice
157	  # number is the identity, otherwise the exact tuple is compared.
158	  defp candidate_filters(query, %ExtractedData{invoice_number: number} = data) do
159	    if invoice_number?(number) do
160	      where(
161	        query,
162	        [je],
163	        fragment("lower(btrim(?)) = lower(btrim(?))", je.invoice_number, ^number)
164	      )
165	    else
166	      soft_match_filters(query, data)
167	    end
168	  end
169	
170	  # The unnumbered tuple needs every component; a missing or malformed one
171	  # (for example, a nil amount or a non-ISO date) never matches.
172	  defp soft_match_filters(query, %ExtractedData{
173	         amount_to_pay_cents: amount,
174	         invoice_date: invoice_date,
175	         currency: currency
176	       })
177	       when is_integer(amount) and is_binary(invoice_date) and is_binary(currency) do

214	  @doc """
215	  Builds an `Ecto.Multi` that creates the journal entry and its tax deduction
216	  claim for an approved/amended review decision.
217	
218	  The step names (`:journal_entry`, `:tax_deduction_claim`) are stable so
219	  callers can compose this multi into a larger transaction, such as the
220	  review-to-journal-entry transition that must roll back on a duplicate
221	  invoice.
222	
223	  Options:
224	
225	    * `:source_document_sha256` — the source document's fingerprint, copied
226	      to the entry as an immutable posting-time snapshot.
227	    * `:source_file_reuse_confirmed` — `true` only when the reviewer explicitly
228	      confirmed a reuse of the same file; defaults to `false`.
229	    * `:booking` — a map with `category`, `need_or_want` and `notes`. When
230	      given, the entry is categorized and posted in the same multi (step
231	      `:posted_journal_entry`), so an invoice can be checked and booked in one
232	      step. Without it the entry stays `uncategorized`.
233	  """
234	  @spec create_multi_from_decision(ReviewDecision.t(), map(), keyword()) :: Ecto.Multi.t()
235	  def create_multi_from_decision(
236	        %ReviewDecision{} = decision,
237	        tax_claim_attrs \\ %{},
238	        opts \\ []
239	      ) do
240	    data = decision.decision_data || decision.original_data
241	
242	    attrs = %{
243	      review_decision_id: decision.id,
244	      user_id: decision.user_id,
245	      amount_cents: data.amount_to_pay_cents,
246	      currency: data.currency,
247	      date: parse_date(data.invoice_date),
248	      description: data.reason_for_payment,
249	      issuer: data.issuer,
250	      invoice_number: data.invoice_number,
251	      status: "uncategorized",
252	      source_document_sha256: Keyword.get(opts, :source_document_sha256),
253	      source_file_reuse_confirmed: Keyword.get(opts, :source_file_reuse_confirmed, false)
254	    }
255	
256	    tax_claim_attrs = normalize_tax_claim_attrs(attrs.amount_cents, tax_claim_attrs)
257	
258	    Multi.new()
259	    |> Multi.insert(:journal_entry, JournalEntry.changeset_for_create(attrs))
260	    |> Multi.run(:tax_deduction_claim, fn repo, %{journal_entry: entry} ->
261	      TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_create(entry, tax_claim_attrs) |> repo.insert()
262	    end)
263	    |> maybe_post_booking(Keyword.get(opts, :booking))
264	  end

266	  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, nil), do: multi

268	  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, booking) when is_map(booking) do
269	    Multi.update(multi, :posted_journal_entry, fn %{journal_entry: entry} ->
270	      booking = Map.new(booking, fn {key, value} -> {to_string(key), value} end)

275	      posted_event_changeset(entry, claim.status)
276	    end)
277	  end

396	  @doc """
397	  Returns posted spending totals for the month containing `reference_date`.

399	  def monthly_spending(%Scope{user: user}, %Date{} = reference_date) do
400	    user_id = user.id
401	    month_start = Date.beginning_of_month(reference_date)
402	    next_month_start = month_start |> Date.add(32) |> Date.beginning_of_month()
403	
404	    categories =
405	      from(je in JournalEntry,
406	        where:
407	          je.user_id == ^user_id and
408	            je.status == "posted" and
409	            not is_nil(je.category) and
410	            fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", je.category) and
411	            je.date >= ^month_start and
412	            je.date < ^next_month_start,
413	        group_by: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
414	        order_by: [desc: sum(je.amount_cents)],
415	        select: %{
416	          category: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
417	          total_cents: sum(je.amount_cents),
418	          entry_count: count(je.id)
419	        }
420	      )
421	      |> Repo.all()
422	      |> Enum.map(fn category ->
423	        %{category | category: humanize_category(category.category)}
424	      end)
425	
426	    %{
427	      month_start: month_start,
428	      currency: user.base_currency,
429	      total_cents: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.total_cents),
430	      entry_count: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.entry_count),
431	      categories: categories
432	    }
433	  end

436	  Returns the distinct categories the scoped user has already assigned, sorted

444	  def list_categories(%Scope{user: user}) do

452	      order_by: [desc: je.updated_at, desc: je.id],

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
4	  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.
5	
6	  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
7	  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
8	  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
9	  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.
10	
11	  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
12	  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
13	  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
14	  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.
15	
16	  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
17	  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
18	  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
19	  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
20	  of the journal.
21	  """
22	
23	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
24	
25	  alias Ecto.Multi
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
32	
33	  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"
34	
35	  @type match :: %{
36	          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
37	          required(:document_id) => integer(),
38	          required(:category) => String.t(),
39	          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
40	          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
41	          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
42	          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
43	        }
44	
45	  @type unmatched :: %{
46	          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
47	          document_id: integer(),
48	          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
49	        }
50	
51	  @type summary :: %{
52	          confirmed: boolean(),
53	          matched: [match()],
54	          applied: [match()],
55	          unmatched: [unmatched()],
56	          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
57	        }
58	
59	  @doc """
60	  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.
61	
62	  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
63	  expected and left for manual booking.
64	
65	  Options:
66	
67	    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
68	    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
69	      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
70	  """
71	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
72	  def run(opts \\ []) do
73	    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
74	    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, %{}))
75	    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)
76	
77	    summary = %{
78	      confirmed: confirmed,
79	      matched: matched,
80	      applied: applied,
81	      unmatched: unmatched,
82	      failed: failed
83	    }
84	
85	    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
86	  end
87	
88	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
89	  def format_summary(summary) do
90	    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
91	    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"
92	
93	    [
94	      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
95	        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
96	        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
97	      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
98	      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
99	      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
100	      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
101	    ]
102	    |> List.flatten()
103	    |> Enum.join("\n")
104	  end
105	
106	  defp plan(manual) do
107	    precedents = precedents()
108	
109	    targets()
110	    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
111	    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
112	    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
113	  end
114	
115	  defp targets do
116	    Repo.all(
117	      from e in JournalEntry,
118	        join: d in ReviewDecision,
119	        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
120	        join: c in ExtractedContent,
121	        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
122	        left_join: t in TaxDeductionClaim,
123	        on: t.journal_entry_id == e.id,
124	        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
125	        order_by: e.id,
126	        select: %{
127	          entry: e,
128	          document_id: c.document_id,
129	          tax_status: t.status,
130	          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
131	        }
132	    )
133	  end
134	
135	  defp precedents do
136	    from(e in JournalEntry,
137	      where: e.status == "posted",
138	      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
139	      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
140	      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
141	      select: %{
142	        user_id: e.user_id,
143	        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
144	        category: e.category,
145	        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
146	        count: count(e.id)
147	      }
148	    )
149	    |> Repo.all()
150	    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
151	  end
152	
153	  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
154	    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id, :tax_status])
155	
156	    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
157	      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
158	      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
163	    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
164	      [] ->
165	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}
166	
167	      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
168	        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()
169	
170	        {:matched,
171	         Map.merge(row, %{
172	           category: category,
173	           need_or_want: need_or_want,
174	           precedent_count: precedent_count,
175	           source: :precedent
176	         })}
177	
178	      _conflicting ->
179	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
180	    end
181	  end
182	
183	  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
184	  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
185	    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
186	  end
187	
188	  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}
189	
190	  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
191	    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})
192	
193	    %{
194	      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
195	      failed:
196	        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
197	          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
198	        end
199	    }
200	  end
201	
202	  defp apply_match(%{source: :manual, entry: entry} = match) do
203	    Accounting.post_entry(
204	      entry,
205	      entry.user_id,
206	      match.category,
207	      match.need_or_want,
208	      entry.notes,
209	      %{"status" => match.tax_status}
210	    )
211	  end
212	
213	  defp apply_match(%{source: :precedent} = match) do
214	    Multi.new()
215	    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
216	    |> Multi.insert(:event, &event_changeset(&1.entry, match))
217	    |> Repo.transaction()
218	    |> case do
219	      {:ok, changes} -> {:ok, changes}
220	      {:error, _step, changeset, _changes} -> {:error, changeset}
221	    end
222	  end
223	
224	  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
225	    entry
226	    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
227	      category: match.category,
228	      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
229	      status: "posted"
230	    })
231	    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
232	  end
233	
234	  defp event_changeset(booked_entry, %{entry: previous} = match) do
235	    Accounting.posted_event_changeset(booked_entry, match.tax_status, %{
236	      source: @source,
237	      precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
238	      previous_status: previous.status,
239	      previous_category: previous.category,
240	      previous_need_or_want: previous.need_or_want
241	    })
242	  end
243	
244	  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
245	    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
246	      match_origin(match) <> "."
247	  end
248	
249	  defp match_origin(%{source: :manual, tax_status: tax_status}),
250	    do: "from a manual decision, tax status #{tax_status}"
251	
252	  defp match_origin(%{source: :precedent, precedent_count: count}),
253	    do: "from #{count} earlier posting(s)"
254	
255	  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
256	    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
257	      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
258	  end
259	
260	  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
261	  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"
262	
263	  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
264	    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
265	  end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Idempotent, online backfill of exact-byte fingerprints for rows created
4	  before fingerprints existed.
5	
6	  1. Every document with a null `content_sha256` is read through
7	     `ZaimuTomo.Storage` and hashed. A missing or unreadable object is
8	     reported and left null; no other value is ever stored in its place.
9	  2. Every journal entry with a null `source_document_sha256` receives its
10	     source document's fingerprint, one entry per update and oldest first, so
11	     the first posting of a file keeps it. A unique-index violation (a same-user
12	     historical duplicate) affects only that row: it is reported with the entry
13	     it collides with and left null. Ledger rows are never deleted or merged.
14	
15	  A human may resolve a reported collision by listing the later entry in
16	  `:confirm_reuse`; the backfill then sets its digest and
17	  `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. This is the only permitted
18	  update of an existing entry's fingerprint (spec D7), so it must run before
19	  any database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` exists, or that
20	  trigger must allow it.
21	
22	  The report contains row IDs and counts only, never bytes or digests. The
23	  partial unique index already exists, so concurrent postings cannot create a
24	  same-user duplicate while this runs.
25	  """
26	
27	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
28	
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
32	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
33	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
34	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
35	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
36	
37	  @type collision :: %{journal_entry_id: integer(), user_id: integer(), conflicts_with: integer()}
38	
39	  @type summary :: %{
40	          documents_hashed: non_neg_integer(),
41	          documents_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
42	          missing_objects: [integer()],
43	          read_failures: [%{document_id: integer(), reason: term()}],
44	          entries_updated: non_neg_integer(),
45	          entries_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
46	          entries_reuse_confirmed: [integer()],
47	          entries_source_unavailable: [integer()],
48	          collisions: [collision()],
49	          unused_reuse_confirmations: [integer()]
50	        }
51	
52	  @doc """
53	  Runs the backfill.
54	
55	  Returns `{:ok, summary}` when historical coverage is complete, and
56	  `{:error, summary}` when any object is missing or unreadable, an entry's
57	  source fingerprint is unavailable, or a collision awaits human review.
58	
59	  Options:
60	
61	    * `:confirm_reuse` — journal entry IDs a human confirmed as legitimate
62	      reuses of an already posted file. Applied only to an entry whose plain
63	      update collides; otherwise reported as unused.
64	  """
65	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
66	  def run(opts \\ []) do
67	    confirm_reuse = opts |> Keyword.get(:confirm_reuse, []) |> MapSet.new()
68	
69	    summary =
70	      empty_summary()
71	      |> backfill_documents()
72	      |> backfill_journal_entries(confirm_reuse)
73	      |> finalize(confirm_reuse)
74	
75	    if complete?(summary), do: {:ok, summary}, else: {:error, summary}
76	  end
77	
78	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
79	  def format_summary(summary) do
80	    [
81	      "Fingerprint backfill summary: " <>
82	        "documents_hashed=#{summary.documents_hashed} " <>
83	        "documents_already_complete=#{summary.documents_already_complete} " <>
84	        "missing_objects=#{length(summary.missing_objects)} " <>
85	        "read_failures=#{length(summary.read_failures)} " <>
86	        "entries_updated=#{summary.entries_updated} " <>
87	        "entries_already_complete=#{summary.entries_already_complete} " <>
88	        "entries_reuse_confirmed=#{length(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)} " <>
89	        "entries_source_unavailable=#{length(summary.entries_source_unavailable)} " <>
90	        "collisions=#{length(summary.collisions)}"
91	      | Enum.map(summary.missing_objects, &"Missing object for document #{&1}") ++
92	          Enum.map(summary.read_failures, &format_read_failure/1) ++
93	          Enum.map(summary.entries_source_unavailable, &format_source_unavailable/1) ++
94	          Enum.map(summary.collisions, &format_collision/1) ++
95	          Enum.map(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed, &"Confirmed reuse for journal entry #{&1}") ++
96	          Enum.map(summary.unused_reuse_confirmations, &format_unused_confirmation/1) ++
97	          coverage_line(summary)
98	    ]
99	    |> Enum.join("\n")
100	  end
101	
102	  # -- Documents ---------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	  defp backfill_documents(summary) do
105	    already_complete =
106	      Repo.aggregate(from(d in Document, where: not is_nil(d.content_sha256)), :count)
107	
108	    from(d in Document,
109	      where: is_nil(d.content_sha256),
110	      order_by: [asc: d.id],
111	      select: {d.id, d.object_key}
112	    )
113	    |> Repo.all()
114	    |> Enum.reduce(%{summary | documents_already_complete: already_complete}, &hash_document/2)
115	  end
116	
117	  defp hash_document({document_id, object_key}, summary) do
118	    case Storage.read_object(object_key) do
119	      {:ok, body} ->
120	        # Conditional on the same key and a still-null digest, so a concurrent
121	        # file replacement (which records its own digest) is never overwritten.
122	        {count, _} =
123	          from(d in Document,
124	            where:
125	              d.id == ^document_id and d.object_key == ^object_key and
126	                is_nil(d.content_sha256)
127	          )
128	          |> Repo.update_all(set: [content_sha256: Fingerprint.sha256(body)])
129	
130	        if count == 1,
131	          do: %{summary | documents_hashed: summary.documents_hashed + 1},
132	          else: %{summary | documents_already_complete: summary.documents_already_complete + 1}
133	
134	      {:error, :not_found} ->
135	        %{summary | missing_objects: [document_id | summary.missing_objects]}
136	
137	      {:error, reason} ->
138	        failure = %{document_id: document_id, reason: reason}
139	        %{summary | read_failures: [failure | summary.read_failures]}
140	    end
141	  end
142	
143	  # -- Journal entries ---------------------------------------------------------
144	
145	  defp backfill_journal_entries(summary, confirm_reuse) do
146	    already_complete =
147	      Repo.aggregate(
148	        from(je in JournalEntry, where: not is_nil(je.source_document_sha256)),
149	        :count
150	      )
151	
152	    from(je in JournalEntry,
153	      left_join: rd in ReviewDecision,
154	      on: rd.id == je.review_decision_id,
155	      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
156	      on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id and ec.user_id == je.user_id,
157	      left_join: d in Document,
158	      on: d.id == ec.document_id and d.user_id == je.user_id,
159	      where: is_nil(je.source_document_sha256),
160	      order_by: [asc: je.inserted_at, asc: je.id],
161	      select: {je, d.content_sha256}
162	    )
163	    |> Repo.all()
164	    |> Enum.reduce(
165	      %{summary | entries_already_complete: already_complete},
166	      &backfill_entry(&1, &2, confirm_reuse)
167	    )
168	  end
169	
170	  defp backfill_entry({entry, nil}, summary, _confirm_reuse) do
171	    %{summary | entries_source_unavailable: [entry.id | summary.entries_source_unavailable]}
172	  end
173	
174	  defp backfill_entry({entry, digest}, summary, confirm_reuse) do
175	    case update_entry(entry, %{source_document_sha256: digest}) do
176	      {:ok, _entry} ->
177	        %{summary | entries_updated: summary.entries_updated + 1}
178	
179	      {:error, :collision} ->
180	        if MapSet.member?(confirm_reuse, entry.id) do
181	          confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary)
182	        else
183	          collision = %{
184	            journal_entry_id: entry.id,
185	            user_id: entry.user_id,
186	            conflicts_with: conflicting_entry_id(entry.user_id, digest)
187	          }
188	
189	          %{summary | collisions: [collision | summary.collisions]}
190	        end
191	    end
192	  end
193	
194	  defp confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary) do
195	    attrs = %{source_document_sha256: digest, source_file_reuse_confirmed: true}
196	
197	    # A confirmed reuse is outside the partial index, so it cannot collide.
198	    {:ok, _entry} = update_entry(entry, attrs)
199	    %{summary | entries_reuse_confirmed: [entry.id | summary.entries_reuse_confirmed]}
200	  end
201	
202	  # The fingerprint is derived metadata, not an edit: keep `updated_at`, which
203	  # orders the user's journal list.
204	  defp update_entry(entry, attrs) do
205	    entry
206	    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(attrs)
207	    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
208	    |> Repo.update()
209	    |> case do
210	      {:ok, entry} ->
211	        {:ok, entry}
212	
213	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
214	        if source_file_collision?(changeset),
215	          do: {:error, :collision},
216	          else: raise(Ecto.InvalidChangesetError, action: :update, changeset: changeset)
217	    end
218	  end
219	
220	  defp source_file_collision?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
221	    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
222	      opts[:constraint] == :unique and
223	        opts[:constraint_name] == JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
224	    end)
225	  end
226	
227	  defp conflicting_entry_id(user_id, digest) do
228	    from(je in JournalEntry,
229	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^digest,
230	      where: not je.source_file_reuse_confirmed,
231	      select: je.id,
232	      limit: 1
233	    )
234	    |> Repo.one()
235	  end
236	
237	  # -- Summary -----------------------------------------------------------------
238	
239	  defp empty_summary do
240	    %{
241	      documents_hashed: 0,
242	      documents_already_complete: 0,
243	      missing_objects: [],
244	      read_failures: [],
245	      entries_updated: 0,
246	      entries_already_complete: 0,
247	      entries_reuse_confirmed: [],
248	      entries_source_unavailable: [],
249	      collisions: [],
250	      unused_reuse_confirmations: []
251	    }
252	  end
253	
254	  defp finalize(summary, confirm_reuse) do
255	    applied = MapSet.new(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)
256	
257	    %{
258	      summary
259	      | missing_objects: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_objects),
260	        read_failures: Enum.reverse(summary.read_failures),
261	        entries_reuse_confirmed: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed),
262	        entries_source_unavailable: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_source_unavailable),
263	        collisions: Enum.reverse(summary.collisions),
264	        unused_reuse_confirmations: confirm_reuse |> MapSet.difference(applied) |> Enum.sort()
265	    }
266	  end
267	
268	  defp complete?(summary) do
269	    summary.missing_objects == [] and summary.read_failures == [] and
270	      summary.entries_source_unavailable == [] and summary.collisions == []
271	  end
272	
273	  defp coverage_line(summary) do
274	    if complete?(summary),
275	      do: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is complete."],
276	      else: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is INCOMPLETE; see the rows above."]
277	  end
278	
279	  defp format_read_failure(%{document_id: id, reason: reason}),
280	    do: "Read failure for document #{id}: #{inspect(reason)}"
281	
282	  defp format_source_unavailable(id),
283	    do: "Journal entry #{id}: source document fingerprint unavailable"
284	
285	  defp format_collision(%{journal_entry_id: id, user_id: user_id, conflicts_with: other}),
286	    do:
287	      "Collision: journal entry #{id} (user #{user_id}) has the same source file as " <>
288	        "entry #{other}; left null for human ledger review"
289	
290	  defp format_unused_confirmation(id),
291	    do: "Reuse confirmation for journal entry #{id} not applied (no collision to resolve)"
292	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The Documents context.
4	  """
5	
6	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
7	
8	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
9	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing
10	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
11	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
13	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
15	
16	  @doc """
17	  Returns a portable object key for an uploaded file.
18	  """
19	  def object_key_for(filename) when is_binary(filename) do
20	    "documents/#{Ecto.UUID.generate()}#{Path.extname(filename)}"
21	  end
22	
23	  @doc """
24	  Reads an uploaded file, stores its bytes, and fingerprints them.
25	
26	  The SHA-256 is computed over the exact binary passed to
27	  `Storage.put_object/2`, so the returned key and digest always describe the
28	  same bytes. Returns attributes ready for `create_document/2` or
29	  `update_document/3`; the caller owns deleting the object if persisting the
30	  row fails.
31	
32	  ## Examples
33	
34	      iex> store_upload("/tmp/plug-123", "invoice.pdf")
35	      {:ok, %{object_key: "documents/….pdf", filename: "invoice.pdf", content_sha256: "…"}}
36	
37	  """
38	  @spec store_upload(Path.t(), String.t()) ::
39	          {:ok, %{object_key: String.t(), filename: String.t(), content_sha256: String.t()}}
40	          | {:error, term()}
41	  def store_upload(path, filename) when is_binary(path) and is_binary(filename) do
42	    object_key = object_key_for(filename)
43	
44	    with {:ok, body} <- File.read(path),
45	         content_sha256 = Fingerprint.sha256(body),
46	         {:ok, ^object_key} <- Storage.put_object(object_key, body) do
47	      {:ok, %{object_key: object_key, filename: filename, content_sha256: content_sha256}}
48	    else
49	      {:ok, _other_key} -> {:error, :unexpected_object_key}
50	      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
51	    end
52	  end
53	
54	  @doc """
55	  Subscribes to scoped notifications about any document changes.
56	
57	  The broadcasted messages match the pattern:
58	
59	    * {:created, %Document{}}
60	    * {:updated, %Document{}}
61	    * {:deleted, %Document{}}
62	
63	  """
64	  def subscribe_documents(%Scope{} = scope) do
65	    Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, documents_topic(scope))
66	  end
67	
68	  defp broadcast_document(%Scope{} = scope, message) do
69	    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, documents_topic(scope), message)
70	  end
71	
72	  defp documents_topic(%Scope{} = scope), do: "user:#{scope.user.id}:documents"
73	
74	  @doc """
75	  Returns the list of documents.
76	
77	  ## Examples
78	
79	      iex> list_documents(scope)
80	      [%Document{}, ...]
81	
82	  """
83	  def list_documents(%Scope{} = scope) do
84	    ec_query =
85	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
86	        order_by: [desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id],
87	        preload: [review_decision: :journal_entry]
88	
89	    from(d in Document,
90	      where: d.user_id == ^scope.user.id,
91	      order_by: [desc: d.inserted_at],
92	      preload: [extracted_content: ^ec_query]
93	    )
94	    |> Repo.all()
95	  end
96	
97	  @doc """
98	  Returns every persisted document object key in a stable order.
99	
100	  This is intentionally unscoped because storage maintenance commands verify
101	  the complete document collection.
102	  """
103	  def list_document_object_keys do
104	    from(d in Document,
105	      order_by: [asc: d.id],
106	      select: d.object_key
107	    )
108	    |> Repo.all()
109	  end
110	
111	  @doc """
112	  Gets a single document.
113	
114	  Raises `Ecto.NoResultsError` if the Document does not exist.
115	
116	  ## Examples
117	
118	      iex> get_document!(scope, 123)
119	      %Document{}
120	
121	      iex> get_document!(scope, 456)
122	      ** (Ecto.NoResultsError)
123	
124	  """
125	  def get_document!(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
126	    Repo.get_by!(Document, id: id, user_id: scope.user.id)
127	  end
128	
129	  @doc """
130	  Fetches a document within the authenticated scope.
131	
132	  Returns `{:error, :not_found}` when the document does not exist or belongs to
133	  another user, so callers can treat inaccessible documents as missing.
134	
135	  ## Examples
136	
137	      iex> fetch_document(scope, "123")
138	      {:ok, %Document{}}
139	
140	      iex> fetch_document(scope, "999")
141	      {:error, :not_found}
142	
143	  """
144	  def fetch_document(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
145	    case Repo.get_by(Document, id: id, user_id: scope.user.id) do
146	      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
147	      document -> {:ok, document}
148	    end
149	  end
150	
151	  def get_document_with_content!(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
152	    ec_query =
153	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
154	        order_by: [desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id],
155	        preload: :review_decision
156	
157	    Document
158	    |> Repo.get_by!(id: id, user_id: scope.user.id)
159	    |> Repo.preload(extracted_content: ec_query)
160	  end
161	
162	  @doc """
163	  Creates a document.
164	
165	  ## Examples
166	
167	      iex> create_document(scope, %{field: value})
168	      {:ok, %Document{}}
169	
170	      iex> create_document(scope, %{field: bad_value})
171	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
172	
173	  """
174	  def create_document(%Scope{} = scope, attrs) do
175	    Ecto.Multi.new()
176	    |> Ecto.Multi.insert(:document, Document.changeset(%Document{}, attrs, scope))
177	    |> Oban.insert(:ocr_job, fn %{document: document} ->
178	      DocumentProcessing.ocr_job(document, scope.user.base_currency, nil)
179	    end)
180	    |> Repo.transaction()
181	    |> case do
182	      {:ok, %{document: document}} ->
183	        broadcast_document(scope, {:created, document})
184	        {:ok, document}
185	
186	      {:error, :document, changeset, _changes} ->
187	        {:error, changeset}
188	
189	      # Should not happen: the job insert runs in the same transaction and its
190	      # failure rolls back the document. Mapped to a changeset so upload callers
191	      # still clean up the stored object on any insert failure.
192	      {:error, :ocr_job, changeset, _changes} ->
193	        {:error, changeset}
194	    end
195	  end
196	
197	  @doc """
198	  Updates a document.
199	
200	  ## Examples
201	
202	      iex> update_document(scope, document, %{field: new_value})
203	      {:ok, %Document{}}
204	
205	      iex> update_document(scope, document, %{field: bad_value})
206	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
207	
208	  """
209	  def update_document(%Scope{} = scope, %Document{} = document, attrs) do
210	    true = document.user_id == scope.user.id
211	
212	    with {:ok, document = %Document{}} <-
213	           document
214	           |> Document.changeset(attrs, scope)
215	           |> Repo.update() do
216	      broadcast_document(scope, {:updated, document})
217	      {:ok, document}
218	    end
219	  end
220	
221	  @doc """
222	  Deletes a document.
223	
224	  ## Examples
225	
226	      iex> delete_document(scope, document)
227	      {:ok, %Document{}}
228	
229	      iex> delete_document(scope, document)
230	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
231	
232	  """
233	  def delete_document(%Scope{} = scope, %Document{} = document) do
234	    true = document.user_id == scope.user.id
235	
236	    document
237	    |> Ecto.Changeset.change()
238	    |> Ecto.Changeset.foreign_key_constraint(:id,
239	      name: :journal_entries_review_decision_id_fkey,
240	      message: "has a posted journal entry and cannot be deleted"
241	    )
242	    |> Repo.delete()
243	    |> case do
244	      {:ok, document} ->
245	        _ = Storage.delete_object(document.object_key)
246	        broadcast_document(scope, {:deleted, document})
247	        {:ok, document}
248	
249	      {:error, changeset} ->
250	        {:error, changeset}
251	    end
252	  end
253	
254	  @doc """
255	  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for tracking document changes.
256	
257	  ## Examples
258	
259	      iex> change_document(scope, document)
260	      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %Document{}}
261	
262	  """
263	  def change_document(%Scope{} = scope, %Document{} = document, attrs \\ %{}) do

2	  @moduledoc """

29	  end

39	  end

44	  end
45

49	  end
50	
51	  def recover_stuck_documents!(opts \\ []) do
52	    start_app()
53	    groups = DocumentProcessing.Recovery.list_stuck()
54	    Enum.each(groups, &print_stuck_group/1)
55	
56	    dispatch_recovery(Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false), groups)
57	  end
58	
59	  defp dispatch_recovery(true, groups) do
60	    jobs = DocumentProcessing.Recovery.enqueue_stuck(groups)
61	    IO.puts("Enqueued #{length(jobs)} OCR jobs.")
62	    groups
63	  end
64	
65	  defp dispatch_recovery(false, groups) do
66	    count = groups |> Enum.map(&length(&1.document_ids)) |> Enum.sum()
67	    IO.puts("Dry run: #{count} stuck documents — nothing enqueued.")
68	    IO.puts("Re-run with confirm: true (or CONFIRM=true) to enqueue.")
69	    groups
70	  end

74	  end

82	  end

84	  defp start_app do
85	    load_app()
86	
87	    # Eval nodes run maintenance only: no queues, no plugins, no leadership, so
88	    # a short-lived node never grabs a job and dies mid-run (leaving it orphaned
89	    # until Lifeline rescues it).
90	    oban = Application.fetch_env!(@app, Oban)
91	
92	    Application.put_env(
93	      @app,
94	      Oban,
95	      Keyword.merge(oban, queues: false, plugins: false, peer: false)
96	    )
97	
98	    case Application.ensure_all_started(@app) do
99	      {:ok, _started} -> :ok
100	      {:error, reason} -> raise "could not start #{@app}: #{inspect(reason)}"
101	    end
102	  end
103

107	    case status do

109	      :error -> raise "maintenance command failed"
110	    end
111	  end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Worker do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The OCR -> extraction -> verification pipeline for a single document.
4	
5	  `run/1` executes one attempt and returns `{:ok, content} | {:error, reason}`.
6	  It persists a SUCCESS row itself but never persists a failure: the durable
7	  `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob` decides whether and when to record a
8	  failure based on `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ErrorClassification` and the
9	  attempt number, so retries never multiply failed rows.
10	
11	  Every terminal write (success and failure rows) is serialized per document:
12	  inside its transaction it locks the document row and re-checks the latest
13	  extraction against the expected id from enqueue time, so overlapping
14	  executions cannot append two terminal rows. A changed document rolls back
15	  with `:already_processed`; a deleted one with `:document_deleted`.
16	
17	  The TypeSafe shadow enqueue is fail-open: a changeset-level enqueue failure
18	  commits the extraction with an `enqueue_failed` shadow (the job insert is
19	  savepoint-isolated inside the success transaction), while a raised DB
20	  exception still rolls back the whole terminal write and surfaces to the
21	  durable `OCRJob` for retry.
22	  """
23	
24	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing
25	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.DocumentOCR
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.TemporaryFile
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review
32	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
33	  import Ecto.Query, only: [from: 2]
34	  require Logger
35	
36	  @doc """
37	  Runs one processing attempt for a self-contained command:
38	
39	      %{document: %Document{}, currency_hint: String.t(), supersedes_extraction_id: id | nil}
40	
41	  Returns `{:ok, %ExtractedContent{}}` when a success row was persisted,
42	  `{:error, :already_processed | :document_deleted}` when the terminal write
43	  was superseded or the document is gone, or `{:error, reason}` without
44	  persisting anything so the caller can retry or record a single failure.
45	  """
46	  def run(%{
47	        document: %{object_key: object_key} = document,
48	        currency_hint: currency_hint,
49	        supersedes_extraction_id: expected_extraction_id
50	      }) do
51	    Langfuse.trace_document_processing(document, fn ->
52	      trace_id = Langfuse.current_trace_id()
53	
54	      case TemporaryFile.create(object_key) do
55	        {:ok, temporary_path} ->
56	          try do
57	            with {:ok, ^temporary_path} <- Storage.get_object(object_key, temporary_path),
58	                 {:ok, markdown, raw_llm_response} <- DocumentOCR.process(temporary_path),
59	                 {:ok, extracted_data} <-
60	                   ZaimuTomo.LLMClient.extract_invoice(markdown, currency_hint),
61	                 {:ok, verification} <-
62	                   ZaimuTomo.LLMClient.verify_extraction(markdown, extracted_data) do
63	              persist_and_emit_success(
64	                document,
65	                extracted_data,
66	                raw_llm_response,
67	                verification,
68	                trace_id,
69	                currency_hint,
70	                expected_extraction_id
71	              )
72	            end
73	          after
74	            File.rm(temporary_path)
75	          end
76	
77	        {:error, posix} ->
78	          {:error, {:scratch_unavailable, posix}}
79	      end
80	    end)
81	  end
82	
83	  def persist_and_emit_success(
84	        document,
85	        extracted_data,
86	        raw_llm_response,
87	        verification,
88	        trace_id,
89	        currency_hint,
90	        expected_extraction_id \\ nil
91	      ) do
92	    analysis = %{
93	      "processed_at" => DateTime.utc_now(),
94	      "verification" => verification
95	    }
96	
97	    extraction_params = %{
98	      document_id: document.id,
99	      user_id: document.user_id,
100	      extracted_data: extracted_data,
101	      raw_llm_response: raw_llm_response,
102	      analysis: analysis,
103	      status: "success",
104	      trace_id: trace_id
105	    }
106	
107	    Repo.transaction(fn ->
108	      lock_and_check_latest(document.id, expected_extraction_id)
109	
110	      with {:ok, content} <- ExtractedContentContext.create_extracted_content(extraction_params),
111	           {:ok, _review_decision} <- Review.create_initial_decision(content) do
112	        # The TypeSafe shadow job is inserted in this transaction so a shadow
113	        # run cannot be lost between commit and enqueue.
114	        enqueue_typesafe_shadow(content, currency_hint)
115	        content
116	      else
117	        {:error, changeset} -> Repo.rollback({:persistence_failed, changeset.errors})
118	      end
119	    end)
120	    |> case do
121	      {:ok, content} ->
122	        DocumentProcessing.broadcast_event(:success, document.user_id, %{
123	          document_id: document.id,
124	          extraction_id: content.id,
125	          user_id: document.user_id,
126	          status: :completed,
127	          data: extracted_data,
128	          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
129	        })
130	
131	        {:ok, content}
132	
133	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
134	        {:error, :already_processed}
135	
136	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
137	        {:error, :document_deleted}
138	
139	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
140	        Logger.error(
141	          "[OCR] Failed to persist successful extraction for document #{document.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
142	        )
143	
144	        {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}}
145	    end
146	  end
147	
148	  def persist_and_emit_failure(document, error, expected_extraction_id \\ nil) do
149	    error_details = %{
150	      "type" => error_type(error),
151	      "message" => error_message(error),
152	      "stack_trace" => error_stack_trace(error),
153	      "timestamp" => DateTime.utc_now()
154	    }
155	
156	    # Failed extractions persist an empty extracted-data embed because invoice
157	    # fields are unavailable when processing does not complete.
158	    extraction_params = %{
159	      document_id: document.id,
160	      user_id: document.user_id,
161	      # Empty map - will fail validation as expected
162	      extracted_data: %{},
163	      analysis: %{
164	        "error" => "Extraction failed",
165	        "attempted_at" => DateTime.utc_now()
166	      },
167	      status: "failed",
168	      error_details: error_details
169	    }
170	
171	    Repo.transaction(fn ->
172	      lock_and_check_latest(document.id, expected_extraction_id)
173	
174	      with {:ok, content} <- ExtractedContentContext.create_extracted_content(extraction_params),
175	           {:ok, _review_decision} <- Review.create_failed_decision(content, error) do
176	        content
177	      else
178	        {:error, changeset} -> Repo.rollback({:persistence_failed, changeset.errors})
179	      end
180	    end)
181	    |> case do
182	      {:ok, content} ->
183	        DocumentProcessing.broadcast_event(:failed, document.user_id, %{
184	          document_id: document.id,
185	          extraction_id: content.id,
186	          user_id: document.user_id,
187	          status: :failed,
188	          error: error,
189	          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
190	        })
191	
192	        {:ok, content}
193	
194	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
195	        {:error, :already_processed}
196	
197	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
198	        {:error, :document_deleted}
199	
200	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
201	        Logger.error(
202	          "[OCR] Failed to persist failed extraction for document #{document.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
203	        )
204	
205	        {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}}
206	    end
207	  end
208	
209	  # Serialize one document's terminal write: lock the document row, then
210	  # re-check the latest extraction against the expected id from enqueue time.
211	  # An overlapping run that already appended a row rolls the transaction back
212	  # with :already_processed; a deleted document with :document_deleted.
213	  defp lock_and_check_latest(document_id, expected_extraction_id) do
214	    case Repo.one(from(d in Document, where: d.id == ^document_id, lock: "FOR UPDATE")) do
215	      nil ->
216	        Repo.rollback(:document_deleted)
217	
218	      %Document{} ->
219	        case ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document_id) do
220	          nil when is_nil(expected_extraction_id) -> :ok
221	          %{id: ^expected_extraction_id} -> :ok
222	          _newer -> Repo.rollback(:already_processed)
223	        end
224	    end
225	  end
226	
227	  # TypeSafe shadow runs are best-effort: a failed enqueue is recorded on the
228	  # row but never rolls back the invoice extraction. The currency hint is a
229	  # required argument — a missing hint is a caller bug, never a silent skip.
230	  #
231	  # Only ever called from inside the success transaction (the SAVEPOINT below
232	  # requires an open transaction; there is no fallback path). The job insert is
233	  # isolated with raw-SQL savepoints because Oban drops :mode from insert
234	  # options and Ecto nested transactions are not savepoints. Only a changeset
235	  # error is contained here: a raised exception rolls back the whole terminal
236	  # write and surfaces to the durable OCRJob for retry.
237	  defp enqueue_typesafe_shadow(content, currency_hint) when is_binary(currency_hint) do
238	    if ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeClient.enabled?() do
239	      Repo.query!("SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
240	
241	      case ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeVerification.enqueue(%{
242	             extracted_content_id: content.id,
243	             currency_hint: currency_hint
244	           }) do
245	        {:ok, _job} ->
246	          Repo.query!("RELEASE SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
247	          :ok
248	
249	        {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}} ->
250	          Repo.query!("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
251	
252	          Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification enqueue failed class=enqueue_failed",
253	            typesafe_error_class: "enqueue_failed"
254	          )
255	
256	          _result =
257	            ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(content.id, %{
258	              "status" => "verification_failed",
259	              "error" => "enqueue_failed"
260	            })
261	
262	          :ok
263	      end
264	    else
265	      Logger.debug("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification skipped")
266	    end
267	  end
268	
269	  # Error handling helper functions
270	  defp error_type(error) when is_tuple(error),
271	    do: elem(error, 0) |> to_string()
272	
273	  defp error_type(error) when is_atom(error),
274	    do: Atom.to_string(error)
275	
276	  defp error_type(_error),
277	    do: "unknown"
278	
279	  defp error_message({_tag, %{reason: reason}}) when is_binary(reason), do: reason
280	
281	  defp error_message(error) when is_tuple(error) do
282	    val = elem(error, 1)
283	    if is_binary(val), do: val, else: inspect(val)
284	  end
285	
286	  defp error_message(error) when is_atom(error), do: Atom.to_string(error)
287	  defp error_message(error) when is_binary(error), do: error
288	  defp error_message(error), do: inspect(error)

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Durable OCR -> extraction -> verification run for one document.
4	
5	  Args are a self-contained command resolved at enqueue time: `document_id`,
6	  `currency_hint` (the owner's base currency snapshot) and
7	  `supersedes_extraction_id` (the latest extraction id at enqueue time, or nil).
8	  The job never queries Accounts.
9	
10	  A `{:cancel, reason}` return voids the job: deleted document, already
11	  processed by an earlier attempt after a Lifeline rescue, or a failure whose
12	  failed row could not be recorded. A transient error on a non-final attempt
13	  returns `{:error, ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)}` WITHOUT persisting,
14	  so Oban backs off and retries and no raw provider payload reaches
15	  `oban_jobs.errors`; a permanent error, or a transient error on the final
16	  attempt, persists exactly one failed row and completes.
17	  """
18	  use Oban.Worker,
19	    queue: :documents,
20	    max_attempts: 5,
21	    unique: [
22	      keys: [:document_id],
23	      states: [:available, :scheduled, :executing, :retryable],
24	      period: :infinity
25	    ]
26	
27	  require Logger
28	
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.{ErrorClassification, ExtractedContentContext, Worker}
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
32	
33	  @impl Oban.Worker
34	  def timeout(_job), do: :timer.minutes(10)
35	
36	  @impl Oban.Worker
37	  def perform(%Oban.Job{args: %{"document_id" => id, "currency_hint" => hint} = args} = job) do
38	    with {:ok, document} <- fetch_document(id),
39	         :ok <- ensure_not_superseded(document, args) do
40	      %{
41	        document: document,
42	        currency_hint: hint,
43	        supersedes_extraction_id: Map.get(args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
44	      }
45	      |> Worker.run()
46	      |> handle_result(document, job)
47	    end
48	  end
49	
50	  defp fetch_document(id) do
51	    case Repo.get(Document, id) do
52	      %Document{} = document -> {:ok, document}
53	      nil -> {:cancel, :document_deleted}
54	    end
55	  end
56	
57	  # Idempotency after a Lifeline rescue: if a row was appended since this job
58	  # was enqueued, an earlier attempt already finished its work. Cheap early
59	  # exit only — the authoritative re-check runs under the document-row lock
60	  # inside the persist transaction (see Worker.run/1).
61	  defp ensure_not_superseded(document, args) do
62	    expected = Map.get(args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
63	
64	    case ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id) do
65	      nil when is_nil(expected) -> :ok
66	      %{id: ^expected} -> :ok
67	      _newer -> {:cancel, :already_processed}
68	    end
69	  end
70	
71	  defp handle_result({:ok, _content}, _document, _job), do: :ok
72	
73	  defp handle_result({:error, :already_processed}, _document, _job),
74	    do: {:cancel, :already_processed}
75	
76	  defp handle_result({:error, :document_deleted}, _document, _job),
77	    do: {:cancel, :document_deleted}
78	
79	  defp handle_result({:error, reason}, document, job) do
80	    handle_failure(
81	      ErrorClassification.classify(reason),
82	      final_attempt?(job),
83	      document,
84	      reason,
85	      Map.get(job.args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
86	    )
87	  end
88	
89	  # Transient and not the final attempt: retry without persisting anything.
90	  # Oban keeps only a bounded, body-free summary of the reason.
91	  defp handle_failure(:transient, false, _document, reason, _expected_extraction_id) do
92	    {:error, ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)}
93	  end
94	
95	  # Permanent (any attempt) or transient on the final attempt: record one failure.
96	  defp handle_failure(class, _final?, document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
97	    record_failure(class, document, reason, expected_extraction_id)
98	  end
99	
100	  defp record_failure(class, document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
101	    case Worker.persist_and_emit_failure(document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
102	      {:ok, _content} ->
103	        Logger.warning(
104	          "[OCR] Processing failed for document #{document.id} (#{class}): " <>
105	            ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)
106	        )
107	
108	        :ok
109	
110	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
111	        {:cancel, :already_processed}
112	
113	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
114	        {:cancel, :document_deleted}
115	
116	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
117	        handle_persist_failure(document, errors)
118	    end
119	  end
120	
121	  # The failed row could not be written and the run is not superseded: void the
122	  # job with an actionable audit trail instead of completing silently, so stuck
123	  # detection can surface the document (no row, no live job). The reason kept
124	  # in oban_jobs.errors is a short summary of the changeset error keys, never
125	  # provider payloads.
126	  defp handle_persist_failure(document, errors) do
127	    summary = changeset_error_summary(errors)
128	
129	    Logger.error("[OCR] Could not record failure for document #{document.id}: #{summary}")
130	
131	    {:cancel, {:failure_not_recorded, summary}}
132	  end
133	
134	  defp changeset_error_summary(errors) do
135	    errors |> Keyword.keys() |> Enum.sort() |> Enum.join(",")
136	  end
137	
138	  defp final_attempt?(%Oban.Job{attempt: attempt, max_attempts: max}), do: attempt >= max
139	end
140

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Recovery do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Unscoped maintenance recovery for stuck documents: no extraction row and no
4	  live OCR job (e.g. a run that was lost to a crash or a discarded job).
5	
6	  Grouped per user so each run uses the owner's own base currency snapshot,
7	  mirroring the enqueue-time snapshot semantics of `DocumentProcessing.ocr_job/3`.
8	  """
9	
10	  import Ecto.Query
11	
12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
13	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
17	
18	  @type group :: %{user_id: pos_integer(), currency: String.t(), document_ids: [pos_integer()]}
19	
20	  @doc """
21	  Lists stuck documents (no extraction row, no live OCR job), grouped per user
22	  with that user's base currency.
23	
24	  Intentionally unscoped: maintenance commands operate on the complete document
25	  collection (like `ZaimuTomo.Documents.list_document_object_keys/0`).
26	  """
27	  @spec list_stuck() :: [group()]
28	  def list_stuck do
29	    # Correlated NOT EXISTS with a safe text comparison: a malformed live job
30	    # (missing or non-numeric document_id) neither hides every document (as a
31	    # NULL-poisoned NOT IN would) nor raises (as a ::bigint cast would).
32	    from(d in Document,
33	      as: :doc,
34	      join: u in User,
35	      on: u.id == d.user_id,
36	      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
37	      on: ec.document_id == d.id,
38	      where: is_nil(ec.id),
39	      where:
40	        not exists(
41	          from(j in DocumentProcessing.live_jobs(),
42	            where: fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?::text", j.args, parent_as(:doc).id),
43	            select: 1
44	          )
45	        ),
46	      order_by: [asc: u.id, asc: d.id],
47	      select: %{user_id: u.id, currency: u.base_currency, document_id: d.id}
48	    )
49	    |> Repo.all()
50	    |> Enum.group_by(& &1.user_id)
51	    |> Enum.sort_by(fn {user_id, _rows} -> user_id end)
52	    |> Enum.map(fn {user_id, rows} ->
53	      %{
54	        user_id: user_id,
55	        currency: hd(rows).currency,
56	        document_ids: Enum.map(rows, & &1.document_id)
57	      }
58	    end)
59	  end
60	
61	  @doc """
62	  Enqueues one fresh OCR job per stuck document and returns the enqueued jobs.
63	
64	  Idempotent through OCRJob uniqueness: when a live job already exists for a
65	  document, Oban reports a conflict and no second job is created.
66	  """
67	  @spec enqueue_stuck([group()]) :: [Oban.Job.t()]
68	  def enqueue_stuck(groups) when is_list(groups) do
69	    Enum.flat_map(groups, fn %{currency: currency, document_ids: document_ids} ->
70	      Enum.flat_map(document_ids, fn document_id ->
71	        %Document{id: document_id}
72	        |> DocumentProcessing.ocr_job(currency, nil)
73	        |> Oban.insert()
74	        |> case do
75	          {:ok, %Oban.Job{conflict?: true}} -> []
76	          {:ok, %Oban.Job{} = job} -> [job]
77	        end
78	      end)
79	    end)
80	  end
81	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The DocumentProcessing context.
4	
5	  Builds durable OCR job commands that Oban dispatches. The enqueue is atomic
6	  with the document insert (see `ZaimuTomo.Documents.create_document/2`), so an
7	  upload can never exist without its processing job.
8	
9	  Also owns the processing state of a document and the scope-checked retry
10	  entry point for failed or stuck runs.
11	  """
12	
13	  import Ecto.Query
14	
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
21	
22	  @ocr_job_worker "ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob"
23	  @live_job_states ~w(available scheduled executing retryable)
24	  @event_kinds [:success, :failed, :retried]
25	
26	  @typedoc """
27	  Processing state of a document:
28	
29	    * `:processing` — a live OCR job exists (queued, scheduled or running)
30	    * `:stuck` — no extraction and no live job (the run was lost)
31	    * `:failed` — the latest extraction failed
32	    * `:extracted` — the latest extraction succeeded
33	  """
34	  @type processing_state :: :processing | :stuck | :failed | :extracted
35	
36	  @doc """
37	  Subscribes the caller to the scope owner's processing events.
38	
39	  Messages are the maps broadcast by `broadcast_event/3`: a run finished
40	  (`:success` / `:failed`) or a retry was enqueued (`:retried`). Topics are per
41	  owner, so a subscriber never receives another user's extracted data.
42	  """
43	  @spec subscribe_events(Scope.t()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
44	  def subscribe_events(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}}) do
45	    Enum.find_value(@event_kinds, :ok, fn kind ->
46	      case Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind)) do
47	        :ok -> nil
48	        error -> error
49	      end
50	    end)
51	  end
52	
53	  @doc false
54	  @spec broadcast_event(:success | :failed | :retried, integer(), map()) ::
55	          :ok | {:error, term()}
56	  def broadcast_event(kind, user_id, payload) when kind in @event_kinds do
57	    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind), payload)
58	  end
59	
60	  defp event_topic(user_id, kind), do: "user:#{user_id}:document_processing:#{kind}"
61	
62	  @doc """
63	  Builds the OCR job changeset for a document.
64	
65	  The command is self-contained and resolved at enqueue time: the document id,
66	  a queue-time snapshot of the owner's base currency (`currency_hint`), and the
67	  latest extraction id to supersede (or `nil` when there is none). The worker
68	  pattern-matches this command and never queries Accounts.
69	  """
70	  def ocr_job(%Document{} = document, currency_hint, supersedes_extraction_id) do
71	    OCRJob.new(%{
72	      document_id: document.id,
73	      currency_hint: currency_hint,
74	      supersedes_extraction_id: supersedes_extraction_id
75	    })
76	  end
77	
78	  @doc """
79	  Returns the processing state of a document.
80	  """
81	  @spec processing_state(Document.t()) :: processing_state()
82	  def processing_state(%Document{} = document) do
83	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
84	    classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest)
85	  end
86	
87	  @doc """
88	  Returns the processing state of many documents at once.
89	
90	  Same semantics as `processing_state/1`, but resolved with two queries
91	  (live jobs and latest extraction per document) regardless of how many ids are
92	  given. Use it wherever a list of documents needs their current state.
93	  """
94	  @spec processing_states([pos_integer()]) :: %{pos_integer() => processing_state()}
95	  def processing_states([]), do: %{}
96	
97	  def processing_states(document_ids) when is_list(document_ids) do
98	    live_ids =
99	      live_jobs()
100	      |> where(
101	        [j],
102	        fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args) in ^Enum.map(document_ids, &to_string/1)
103	      )
104	      |> select([j], fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args))
105	      |> Repo.all()
106	      |> MapSet.new()
107	
108	    latest_statuses =
109	      ExtractedContent
110	      |> where([ec], ec.document_id in ^document_ids)
111	      |> distinct([ec], ec.document_id)
112	      |> order_by([ec], asc: ec.document_id, desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id)
113	      |> select([ec], {ec.document_id, ec.status})
114	      |> Repo.all()
115	      |> Map.new()
116	
117	    Map.new(document_ids, fn id ->
118	      latest = latest_statuses[id] && %{status: latest_statuses[id]}
119	      {id, classify_state(MapSet.member?(live_ids, to_string(id)), latest)}
120	    end)
121	  end
122	
123	  defp classify_state(true, _latest), do: :processing
124	  defp classify_state(false, nil), do: :stuck
125	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "failed"}), do: :failed
126	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "success"}), do: :extracted
127	
128	  @doc """
129	  Retries processing for a document whose latest run failed or stalled.
130	
131	  The document must be a persisted struct obtained through a scoped getter
132	  (e.g. `ZaimuTomo.Documents.get_document!/2`), matching the trust model of
133	  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.update_document/3`.
134	  Scope-checked: a document owned by another user returns `{:error, :not_found}`.
135	  Only `:failed` and `:stuck` are retryable; any other state returns
136	  `{:error, {:not_retryable, state}}`. The enqueue carries the latest extraction
137	  id as `supersedes_extraction_id` (nil when stuck), and failed rows are kept as
138	  history — the new run appends a row. An Oban uniqueness conflict counts as
139	  success: at most one live job can exist per document.
140	  """
141	  @spec retry_document(Scope.t(), Document.t()) ::
142	          {:ok, Oban.Job.t()} | {:error, :not_found | {:not_retryable, processing_state()}}
143	  def retry_document(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}} = scope, %Document{user_id: user_id} = document) do
144	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
145	
146	    case classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest) do
147	      state when state in [:failed, :stuck] ->
148	        with {:ok, job} <-
149	               document
150	               |> ocr_job(scope.user.base_currency, latest && latest.id)
151	               |> Oban.insert() do
152	          # Lets open Index / hero views pick up the new live run without a reload.
153	          broadcast_event(:retried, user_id, %{document_id: document.id, user_id: user_id})
154	          {:ok, job}
155	        end
156	
157	      state ->
158	        {:error, {:not_retryable, state}}
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  def retry_document(%Scope{}, %Document{}), do: {:error, :not_found}
163	
164	  @doc """
165	  Returns true when a live OCR job exists for the document.
166	  """
167	  @spec live_job?(pos_integer()) :: boolean()
168	  def live_job?(document_id) do
169	    # Same safe text comparison as Recovery.list_stuck/0: no ::bigint cast on
170	    # job args, so a malformed job (missing or non-numeric document_id) is
171	    # simply not a match and never raises.
172	    live_jobs()
173	    |> where([j], fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?", j.args, ^to_string(document_id)))
174	    |> limit(1)
175	    |> Repo.one()
176	    |> case do
177	      %Oban.Job{} -> true
178	      nil -> false
179	    end
180	  end
181	
182	  @doc """
183	  Base query over live OCR jobs (worker + states that still count as in-flight).
184	  """
185	  @spec live_jobs() :: Ecto.Query.t()
186	  def live_jobs do
187	    from j in Oban.Job,
188	      where: j.worker == @ocr_job_worker,
189	      where: j.state in @live_job_states
190	  end
191	end
