1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for managing extracted content from OCR/LLM processing.
4	  """
5	
6	  import Ecto.Query
7	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
8	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
9	
10	  @doc """
11	  Creates a new extracted content record.
12	
13	  ## Parameters
14	    - attrs: Map containing extracted content data
15	
16	  ## Returns
17	    - {:ok, %ExtractedContent{}} on success
18	    - {:error, changeset} on validation error
19	  """
20	  def create_extracted_content(attrs) do
21	    %ExtractedContent{}
22	    |> ExtractedContent.changeset(attrs)
23	    |> Repo.insert()
24	  end
25	
26	  @doc """
27	  Gets extracted content by ID.
28	
29	  ## Parameters
30	    - extraction_id: ID of the extracted content record
31	
32	  ## Returns
33	    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
34	  """
35	  def get_by_id(extraction_id) do
36	    query =
37	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
38	        where: ec.id == ^extraction_id,
39	        limit: 1
40	
41	    Repo.one(query)
42	  end
43	
44	  @doc """
45	  Persists a TypeSafe shadow result without replacing authoritative verification.
46	  """
47	  @spec put_typesafe_shadow(pos_integer(), map()) ::
48	          {:ok, ExtractedContent.t()} | {:error, term()}
49	  def put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) when is_map(shadow) do
50	    case get_by_id(extraction_id) do
51	      %ExtractedContent{} = content ->
52	        analysis = content.analysis || %{}
53	        verification = Map.get(analysis, "verification", %{})
54	
55	        updated_analysis =
56	          Map.put(analysis, "verification", Map.put(verification, "typesafe_shadow", shadow))
57	
58	        content
59	        |> Ecto.Changeset.change(analysis: updated_analysis)
60	        |> Repo.update()
61	
62	      nil ->
63	        {:error, :extracted_content_not_found}
64	    end
65	  end
66	
67	  @doc """
68	  Gets the latest extraction for a document.
69	
70	  ## Parameters
71	    - document_id: ID of the document
72	
73	  ## Returns
74	    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
75	  """
76	  def get_latest_by_document(document_id) do
77	    query =
78	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
79	        where: ec.document_id == ^document_id,
80	        order_by: [desc: :inserted_at, desc: :id],
81	        limit: 1
82	
83	    Repo.one(query)
84	  end
85	
86	  def get_structured_data(content) when is_map(content) do
87	    # extracted_data is already a struct, just return it
88	    {:ok, content.extracted_data}
89	  end
90	
91	  def get_response_data(content) do
92	    # Convert struct to map for API responses
93	    Map.from_struct(content.extracted_data)
94	  end
95	
96	  def get_analysis(content) do
97	    content.analysis || %{}
98	  end
99	
100	  # Combined response with data and analysis
101	  def get_full_response(content) do
102	    %{
103	      "data" => get_response_data(content),
104	      "analysis" => get_analysis(content),
105	      "status" => content.status,
106	      "extracted_at" => content.inserted_at
107	    }
108	  end
109	
110	  # Get specific fields with type safety
111	  def get_invoice_amount(content) do
112	    content.extracted_data.amount_to_pay_cents
113	  end
114	
115	  def get_invoice_date(content) do
116	    content.extracted_data.invoice_date
117	  end
118	
119	  def get_invoice_number(content) do
120	    content.extracted_data.invoice_number
121	  end

20	
21	  @doc false
22	  def changeset(financial_account, attrs, user_scope) do

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData

  schema "review_decisions" do
    embeds_one :original_data, ExtractedData
    embeds_one :decision_data, ExtractedData
    field :decision_type, :string
    field :rejection_reason, :string
    field :review_completed_at, :utc_datetime
    field :review_notes, :string
    field :review_status, :string

    belongs_to :extracted_content, ExtractedContent
    belongs_to :user, User
    has_one :journal_entry, ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  def effective_data(%__MODULE__{} = decision) do
    decision.decision_data || decision.original_data || %ExtractedData{}
  end

  def changeset_for_create(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :extracted_content_id,
      :user_id,
      :review_status,
      :decision_type,
      :rejection_reason,
      :review_notes,
      :review_completed_at
    ])
    |> cast_embed(:original_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> cast_embed(:decision_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> validate_required([:extracted_content_id, :user_id, :review_status, :decision_type])
    |> validate_inclusion(:review_status, ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended", "failed"])
    |> validate_rejection_reason()
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:extracted_content_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  def changeset_for_update(%__MODULE__{} = review_decision, attrs) do
    review_decision
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :review_status,
      :rejection_reason,
      :review_notes,
      :decision_type,
      :review_completed_at
    ])
    |> cast_embed(:decision_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
    |> validate_inclusion(:review_status, ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended", "failed"])
    |> validate_rejection_reason()
  end

  defp validate_rejection_reason(changeset) do
    if get_field(changeset, :review_status) == "rejected" do
      changeset
      |> validate_required(:rejection_reason)
      |> validate_length(:rejection_reason, max: 1000)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint

  schema "documents" do
    field :filename, :string
    field :object_key, :string
    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
    # backfill reads them. Redacted so it never reaches logs.
    field :content_sha256, :string, redact: true
    field :user_id, :id

    has_many :extracted_content, ExtractedContent

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @doc false
  def changeset(document, attrs, user_scope) do
    document
    |> cast(attrs, [:filename, :object_key, :content_sha256])
    |> validate_required([:filename, :object_key])
    |> validate_format(:content_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
    |> clear_stale_fingerprint()
    |> put_change(:user_id, user_scope.user.id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  # The digest describes the bytes at `object_key`. Replacing the object
  # without a new digest must not leave the old file's digest behind.
  defp clear_stale_fingerprint(changeset) do
    if changed?(changeset, :object_key) and not changed?(changeset, :content_sha256) do
      put_change(changeset, :content_sha256, nil)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document

  schema "extracted_content" do
    embeds_one :extracted_data, ExtractedData
    field :raw_llm_response, :map
    field :status, :string
    field :error_details, :map
    field :analysis, :map
    field :trace_id, :string

    belongs_to :document, Document
    belongs_to :user, ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
    has_one :review_decision, ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

    timestamps()
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  def changeset(extracted_content, attrs) do
    extracted_content
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :document_id,
      :user_id,
      :status,
      :raw_llm_response,
      :error_details,
      :analysis,
      :trace_id
    ])
    |> validate_required([:document_id, :status])
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["success", "failed"])
    |> maybe_cast_extracted_data(attrs)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:document_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  defp maybe_cast_extracted_data(changeset, attrs) do
    case status_from_attrs(attrs) do
      "failed" ->
        put_embed(changeset, :extracted_data, %ExtractedData{})

      _ ->
        changeset
        |> cast_embed(:extracted_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
        |> validate_embedded_data_size()
        |> validate_extracted_data_for_status()
    end
  end

  defp status_from_attrs(attrs), do: Map.get(attrs, :status) || Map.get(attrs, "status")

  defp validate_extracted_data_for_status(changeset) do
    status = get_field(changeset, :status)
    extracted_data = get_field(changeset, :extracted_data)

    case {status, extracted_data} do
      # If it failed, we don't care about the data
      {"failed", _} ->
        changeset

      # If it didn't fail, but the data is nil or an empty map, add an error
      {_, empty_data} when empty_data in [nil, %{}] ->
        add_error(changeset, :extracted_data, "is required for successful extractions")

      _ ->
        changeset
    end
  end

  defp validate_embedded_data_size(changeset) do
    extracted_data = get_field(changeset, :extracted_data)

    case extracted_data do
      nil ->
        changeset

      %ExtractedData{} = data ->
        size = byte_size(Jason.encode!(Map.from_struct(data)))

        if size <= 10_000_000 do
          changeset
        else
          add_error(changeset, :extracted_data, "exceeds maximum size of 10MB")
        end
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency

  @primary_key false
  embedded_schema do
    field(:amount_to_pay_cents, :integer)
    field(:invoice_date, :string)
    field(:invoice_number, :string)
    field(:currency, :string)
    field(:reason_for_payment, :string)
    field(:issuer, :string)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @required_fields [:amount_to_pay_cents, :invoice_date, :currency, :reason_for_payment, :issuer]
  @optional_fields [:invoice_number]

  def changeset(attrs) when is_map(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
    |> validate_required(@required_fields)
  end

  def embedded_changeset(_struct, attrs) do
    if is_struct(attrs, __MODULE__) do
      Ecto.Changeset.change(attrs)
    else
      %__MODULE__{}
      |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
      |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
      |> validate_required(@required_fields)
    end
  end

  def fields, do: @required_fields ++ @optional_fields

  @doc """
  Lists the fields whose value differs between `from` and `to` as
  `{field, from_value, to_value}`, in `fields/0` order. Surrounding whitespace
  is not a difference.
  """
  @spec changes(t(), t()) :: [{atom(), term(), term()}]
  def changes(%__MODULE__{} = from, %__MODULE__{} = to) do
    for field <- fields(),
        comparable(Map.get(from, field)) != comparable(Map.get(to, field)),
        do: {field, Map.get(from, field), Map.get(to, field)}
  end

  defp comparable(value) when is_binary(value), do: String.trim(value)
  defp comparable(value), do: value
end

85

88

90	  than 20 minutes ago. The limit can be given as second argument in minutes.
91	  """

117

119	  """

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounts do
  @moduledoc """
  The Accounts context.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.{User, UserNotifier, UserToken}

  ## Database getters

  @doc """
  Gets a user by email.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user_by_email("foo@example.com")
      %User{}

      iex> get_user_by_email("unknown@example.com")
      nil

  """
  def get_user_by_email(email) when is_binary(email) do
    Repo.get_by(User, email: email)
  end

  @doc """
  Gets a user by email and password.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user_by_email_and_password("foo@example.com", "correct_password")
      %User{}

      iex> get_user_by_email_and_password("foo@example.com", "invalid_password")
      nil

  """
  def get_user_by_email_and_password(email, password)
      when is_binary(email) and is_binary(password) do
    user = Repo.get_by(User, email: email)
    if User.valid_password?(user, password), do: user
  end

  @doc """
  Gets a single user.

  Raises `Ecto.NoResultsError` if the User does not exist.

  ## Examples

      iex> get_user!(123)
      %User{}

      iex> get_user!(456)
      ** (Ecto.NoResultsError)

  """
  def get_user!(id), do: Repo.get!(User, id)

  ## User registration

  @doc """
  Registers a user.

  ## Examples

      iex> register_user(%{field: value})
      {:ok, %User{}}

      iex> register_user(%{field: bad_value})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def register_user(attrs) do
    %User{}
    |> User.email_changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  ## Settings

  @doc """
  Checks whether the user is in sudo mode.

  The user is in sudo mode when the last authentication was done no further
  than 20 minutes ago. The limit can be given as second argument in minutes.
  """
  def sudo_mode?(user, minutes \\ -20)

  def sudo_mode?(%User{authenticated_at: ts}, minutes) when is_struct(ts, DateTime) do
    DateTime.after?(ts, DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.add(minutes, :minute))
  end

  def sudo_mode?(_user, _minutes), do: false

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for changing the user email.

  See `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User.email_changeset/3` for a list of supported options.

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_email(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_email(user, attrs \\ %{}, opts \\ []) do
    User.email_changeset(user, attrs, opts)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user email using the given token.

  If the token matches, the user email is updated and the token is deleted.
  """
  def update_user_email(user, token) do
    context = "change:#{user.email}"

    Repo.transact(fn ->
      with {:ok, query} <- UserToken.verify_change_email_token_query(token, context),
           %UserToken{sent_to: email} <- Repo.one(query),
           {:ok, user} <- Repo.update(User.email_changeset(user, %{email: email})),
           {_count, _result} <-
             Repo.delete_all(from(UserToken, where: [user_id: ^user.id, context: ^context])) do
        {:ok, user}
      else
        _ -> {:error, :transaction_aborted}
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for changing the user password.

  See `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User.password_changeset/3` for a list of supported options.

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_password(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_password(user, attrs \\ %{}, opts \\ []) do
    User.password_changeset(user, attrs, opts)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user password.

  Returns a tuple with the updated user, as well as a list of expired tokens.

  ## Examples

      iex> update_user_password(user, %{password: REDACTED
      {:ok, {%User{}, [...]}}

      iex> update_user_password(user, %{password: "REDACTED"})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def update_user_password(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> User.password_changeset(attrs)
    |> update_user_and_delete_all_tokens()
  end

  @doc """
  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for updating the user profile
  (display name and base currency).

  ## Examples

      iex> change_user_profile(user)
      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %User{}}

  """
  def change_user_profile(user, attrs \\ %{}) do
    User.profile_changeset(user, attrs)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates the user profile (display name and base currency).

  ## Examples

      iex> update_user_profile(user, %{display_name: "Sora", base_currency: "CHF"})
      {:ok, %User{}}

      iex> update_user_profile(user, %{base_currency: "Nope"})
      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}

  """
  def update_user_profile(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> User.profile_changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.update()
  end

  ## Session

  @doc """
  Generates a session token.
  """
  def generate_user_session_token(user) do
    {token, user_token} = UserToken.build_session_token(user)
    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    token
  end

  @doc """
  Gets the user with the given signed token.

  If the token is valid `{user, token_inserted_at}` is returned, otherwise `nil` is returned.
  """
  def get_user_by_session_token(token) do
    {:ok, query} = UserToken.verify_session_token_query(token)
    Repo.one(query)
  end

  @doc """
  Gets the user with the given magic link token.
  """
  def get_user_by_magic_link_token(token) do
    with {:ok, query} <- UserToken.verify_magic_link_token_query(token),
         {user, _token} <- Repo.one(query) do
      user
    else
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Logs the user in by magic link.

  There are three cases to consider:

  1. The user has already confirmed their email. They are logged in
     and the magic link is expired.

  2. The user has not confirmed their email and no password is set.
     In this case, the user gets confirmed, logged in, and all tokens -
     including session ones - are expired. In theory, no other tokens
     exist but we delete all of them for best security practices.

  3. The user has not confirmed their email but a password is set.
     This cannot happen in the default implementation but may be the
     source of security pitfalls. See the "Mixing magic link and password registration" section of
     `mix help phx.gen.auth`.
  """
  def login_user_by_magic_link(token) do
    {:ok, query} = UserToken.verify_magic_link_token_query(token)

    case Repo.one(query) do
      # Prevent session fixation attacks by disallowing magic links for unconfirmed users with password
      {%User{confirmed_at: nil, hashed_password: hash}, _token} when not is_nil(hash) ->
        raise """
        magic link log in is not allowed for unconfirmed users with a password set!

        This cannot happen with the default implementation, which indicates that you
        might have adapted the code to a different use case. Please make sure to read the
        "Mixing magic link and password registration" section of `mix help phx.gen.auth`.
        """

      {%User{confirmed_at: nil} = user, _token} ->
        user
        |> User.confirm_changeset()
        |> update_user_and_delete_all_tokens()

      {user, token} ->
        Repo.delete!(token)
        {:ok, {user, []}}

      nil ->
        {:error, :not_found}
    end
  end

  @doc ~S"""
  Delivers the update email instructions to the given user.

  ## Examples

      iex> deliver_user_update_email_instructions(user, current_email, &url(~p"/users/settings/confirm-email/#{&1}"))
      {:ok, %{to: ..., body: ...}}

  """
  def deliver_user_update_email_instructions(%User{} = user, current_email, update_email_url_fun)
      when is_function(update_email_url_fun, 1) do
    {encoded_token, user_token} = UserToken.build_email_token(user, "change:#{current_email}")

    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    UserNotifier.deliver_update_email_instructions(user, update_email_url_fun.(encoded_token))
  end

  @doc """
  Delivers the magic link login instructions to the given user.
  """
  def deliver_login_instructions(%User{} = user, magic_link_url_fun)
      when is_function(magic_link_url_fun, 1) do
    {encoded_token, user_token} = UserToken.build_email_token(user, "login")
    Repo.insert!(user_token)
    UserNotifier.deliver_login_instructions(user, magic_link_url_fun.(encoded_token))
  end

  @doc """
  Deletes the signed token with the given context.
  """
  def delete_user_session_token(token) do
    Repo.delete_all(from(UserToken, where: [token: ^token, context: "session"]))
    :ok
  end

  ## Token helper

  defp update_user_and_delete_all_tokens(changeset) do
    Repo.transact(fn ->
      with {:ok, user} <- Repo.update(changeset) do
        tokens_to_expire = Repo.all_by(UserToken, user_id: user.id)

        Repo.delete_all(from(t in UserToken, where: t.id in ^Enum.map(tokens_to_expire, & &1.id)))

        {:ok, {user, tokens_to_expire}}
      end
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency

  schema "users" do
    field :email, :string
    field :password, :string, virtual: true, redact: true
    field :hashed_password, :string, redact: true
    field :confirmed_at, :utc_datetime
    field :authenticated_at, :utc_datetime, virtual: true
    field :display_name, :string
    # Mirrors the users.base_currency column default so structs are born with
    # a base currency and fresh inserts return it without a reload.
    field :base_currency, :string, default: "CHF"

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @doc """
  A user changeset for registering or changing the email.

  It requires the email to change otherwise an error is added.

  ## Options

    * `:validate_unique` - Set to false if you don't want to validate the
      uniqueness of the email, useful when displaying live validations.
      Defaults to `true`.
  """
  def email_changeset(user, attrs, opts \\ []) do
    user
    |> cast(attrs, [:email])
    |> validate_email(opts)
  end

  defp validate_email(changeset, opts) do
    changeset =
      changeset
      |> validate_required([:email])
      |> validate_format(:email, ~r/^[^@,;\s]+@[^@,;\s]+$/,
        message: "must have the @ sign and no spaces"
      )
      |> validate_length(:email, max: 160)

    if Keyword.get(opts, :validate_unique, true) do
      changeset
      |> unsafe_validate_unique(:email, ZaimuTomo.Repo)
      |> unique_constraint(:email)
      |> validate_email_changed()
    else
      changeset
    end
  end

  defp validate_email_changed(changeset) do
    if get_field(changeset, :email) && get_change(changeset, :email) == nil do
      add_error(changeset, :email, "did not change")
    else
      changeset
    end
  end

  @doc """
  A user changeset for updating the display name and base currency.

  The display name is trimmed and an empty value is stored as `nil` (unset).
  The base currency is normalized to an uppercase three-letter ISO 4217 code.
  """
  def profile_changeset(user, attrs) do
    user
    |> cast(attrs, [:display_name, :base_currency])
    |> update_change(:display_name, &normalize_display_name/1)
    |> validate_length(:display_name, max: 100)
    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:base_currency)
    |> validate_required([:base_currency])
  end

  defp normalize_display_name(nil), do: nil
  defp normalize_display_name(""), do: nil

  defp normalize_display_name(name) do
    case String.trim(name) do
      "" -> nil
      trimmed -> trimmed
    end
  end

  @doc """
  A user changeset for changing the password.

  It is important to validate the length of the password, as long passwords may
  be very expensive to hash for certain algorithms.

  ## Options

    * `:hash_password` - Hashes the password so it can be stored securely
      in the database and ensures the password field is cleared to prevent
      leaks in the logs. If password hashing is not needed and clearing the
      password field is not desired (like when using this changeset for
      validations on a LiveView form), this option can be set to `false`.
      Defaults to `true`.
  """
  def password_changeset(user, attrs, opts \\ []) do
    user
    |> cast(attrs, [:password])
    |> validate_confirmation(:password, message: "does not match password")
    |> validate_password(opts)
  end

  defp validate_password(changeset, opts) do
    changeset
    |> validate_required([:password])
    |> validate_length(:password, min: 12, max: 72)
    # Examples of additional password validation:
    # |> validate_format(:password, ~r/[a-z]/, message: "at least one lower case character")
    # |> validate_format(:password, ~r/[A-Z]/, message: "at least one upper case character")
    # |> validate_format(:password, ~r/[!?@#$%^&*_0-9]/, message: "at least one digit or punctuation character")
    |> maybe_hash_password(opts)
  end

  defp maybe_hash_password(changeset, opts) do
    hash_password? = Keyword.get(opts, :hash_password, true)
    password = get_change(changeset, :password)

    if hash_password? && password && changeset.valid? do
      changeset
      # If using Bcrypt, then further validate it is at most 72 bytes long
      |> validate_length(:password, max: 72, count: :bytes)
      # Hashing could be done with `Ecto.Changeset.prepare_changes/2`, but that
      # would keep the database transaction open longer and hurt performance.
      |> put_change(:hashed_password, Bcrypt.hash_pwd_salt(password))
      |> delete_change(:password)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Confirms the account by setting `confirmed_at`.
  """
  def confirm_changeset(user) do
    now = DateTime.utc_now(:second)
    change(user, confirmed_at: now)
  end

  @doc """
  Verifies the password.

  If there is no user or the user doesn't have a password, we call
  `Bcrypt.no_user_verify/0` to avoid timing attacks.
  """
  def valid_password?(%ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User{hashed_password: hashed_password}, password)
      when is_binary(hashed_password) and byte_size(password) > 0 do
    Bcrypt.verify_pass(password, hashed_password)
  end

  def valid_password?(_, _) do
    Bcrypt.no_user_verify()
    false
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DevSeeds do
  @moduledoc false

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
  alias ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts
  alias ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts.FinancialAccount
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  @demo_email "demo@zaimutomo.test"
  @demo_password "demo-password-123"

  @accounts [
    %{
      name: "Daily spending",
      account_type: :cash,
      currency: "CHF",
      bank_name: "Zürcher Kantonalbank",
      account_number: "CH93 0070 0116 2014 6868 3",
      source: :bank_sync,
      balance_history: [
        {6, 356_200},
        {4, 389_600},
        {3, 405_100},
        {1, 391_200},
        {0, 423_800}
      ]
    },
    %{
      name: "Emergency fund",
      account_type: :savings,
      currency: "CHF",
      bank_name: "Zürcher Kantonalbank",
      account_number: "CH21 0070 0116 2014 6868 4",
      source: :bank_sync,
      balance_history: [
        {6, 1_420_000},
        {4, 1_460_000},
        {3, 1_495_000},
        {1, 1_535_000},
        {0, 1_580_000}
      ]
    },
    %{
      name: "Travel wallet",
      account_type: :cash,
      currency: "EUR",
      bank_name: "Cash",
      account_number: "EUR travel cash",
      source: :manual,
      balance_history: [
        {6, 18_900},
        {4, 35_200},
        {3, 41_800},
        {1, 30_400},
        {0, 26_550}
      ]
    },
    %{
      name: "Global index fund",
      account_type: :investment,
      currency: "USD",
      bank_name: "Interactive Brokers",
      account_number: "U1234567",
      source: :bank_sync,
      balance_history: [
        {6, 3_930_000},
        {4, 4_080_000},
        {3, 4_160_000},
        {1, 4_230_000},
        {0, 4_275_000}
      ]
    },
    %{
      name: "Pillar 3a",
      account_type: :investment,
      currency: "CHF",
      bank_name: "VIAC",
      account_number: "3a-004281",
      source: :bank_sync,
      balance_history: [
        {6, 8_300_000},
        {4, 8_510_000},
        {3, 8_650_000},
        {1, 8_780_000},
        {0, 8_940_000}
      ]
    }
  ]

  def seed! do
    user = ensure_demo_user!()
    scope = Scope.for_user(user)

    accounts = Enum.map(@accounts, &ensure_account!(scope, &1))

    %{user: user, accounts: accounts}
  end

  def demo_credentials, do: %{email: @demo_email, password: @demo_password}

  defp ensure_demo_user! do
    case Accounts.get_user_by_email(@demo_email) do
      nil ->
        {:ok, user} = Accounts.register_user(%{email: @demo_email})

        {:ok, user} =
          Accounts.update_user_profile(user, %{display_name: "Maya Keller", base_currency: "CHF"})

        {:ok, {user, _expired_tokens}} =
          Accounts.update_user_password(user, %{password: @demo_password})

        user

      user ->
        user
    end
  end

  defp ensure_account!(scope, attrs) do
    balance_history = balance_history(attrs, Date.utc_today())

    account =
      case Repo.get_by(FinancialAccount, user_id: scope.user.id, name: attrs.name) do
        nil ->
          [initial_snapshot | _] = balance_history

          {:ok, %{account: account}} =
            FinancialAccounts.create_financial_account_with_balance(
              scope,
              Map.take(attrs, [
                :name,
                :account_type,
                :currency,
                :bank_name,
                :account_number,
                :source
              ]),
              initial_snapshot
            )

          account

        account ->
          account
      end

    ensure_balance_history!(scope, account, balance_history)

    %{
      account: account,
      balance_snapshot: scope |> FinancialAccounts.list_balance_snapshots(account) |> hd()
    }
  end

  defp balance_history(attrs, today) do
    Enum.map(attrs.balance_history, fn {months_ago, amount_cents} ->
      %{amount_cents: amount_cents, recorded_on: Date.shift(today, month: -months_ago)}
    end)
  end

  defp ensure_balance_history!(scope, account, balance_history) do
    recorded_on_dates =
      scope
      |> FinancialAccounts.list_balance_snapshots(account)
      |> MapSet.new(& &1.recorded_on)

    Enum.each(balance_history, fn snapshot ->
      unless MapSet.member?(recorded_on_dates, snapshot.recorded_on) do
        {:ok, _snapshot} = FinancialAccounts.record_balance(scope, account, snapshot)
      end
    end)
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts.FinancialAccount do
2	  use Ecto.Schema
3	  import Ecto.Changeset
4	
5	  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency
6	
7	  schema "financial_accounts" do
8	    field :name, :string
9	    field :account_type, Ecto.Enum, values: [:cash, :savings, :investment]
10	    field :currency, :string
11	    field :bank_name, :string
12	    field :account_number, :string
13	    field :source, Ecto.Enum, values: [:manual, :bank_sync], default: :manual
14	    field :user_id, :id
15	
16	    has_many :balance_snapshots, ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts.BalanceSnapshot
17	
18	    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
19	  end
20	
21	  @doc false
22	  def changeset(financial_account, attrs, user_scope) do
23	    financial_account
24	    |> cast(attrs, [:name, :account_type, :currency, :bank_name, :account_number, :source])
25	    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
26	    |> validate_required([:name, :account_type, :currency])
27	    |> update_change(:bank_name, &String.trim/1)
28	    |> update_change(:account_number, &String.trim/1)
29	    |> validate_length(:bank_name, max: 255)
30	    |> validate_length(:account_number, max: 255)
31	    |> put_change(:user_id, user_scope.user.id)
32	  end
33	end
34

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry do
2	  use Ecto.Schema
3	  import Ecto.Changeset
4	
5	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
6	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
7	  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency
8	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
9	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
10	
11	  @need_or_want_values ["need", "want"]
12	  @duplicate_invoice_index "journal_entries_user_issuer_number_unique_index"
13	  @duplicate_source_file_index "journal_entries_user_source_document_sha256_unique_index"
14	
15	  @typedoc "Journal entry schema struct"
16	  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
17	          __meta__: Ecto.Schema.Metadata.t(),
18	          id: integer() | nil,
19	          amount_cents: integer() | nil,
20	          currency: String.t() | nil,
21	          date: Date.t() | nil,
22	          description: String.t() | nil,
23	          issuer: String.t() | nil,
24	          invoice_number: String.t() | nil,
25	          category: String.t() | nil,
26	          need_or_want: String.t() | nil,
27	          status: String.t() | nil,
28	          notes: String.t() | nil,
29	          source_document_sha256: String.t() | nil,
30	          source_file_reuse_confirmed: boolean(),
31	          review_decision_id: integer() | nil,
32	          user_id: integer() | nil,
33	          review_decision: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
34	          user: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
35	          tax_deduction_claim: Ecto.Schema.has_one(TaxDeductionClaim.t()),
36	          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
37	          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
38	        }
39	
40	  schema "journal_entries" do
41	    field :amount_cents, :integer
42	    field :currency, :string
43	    field :date, :date
44	    field :description, :string
45	    field :issuer, :string
46	    field :invoice_number, :string
47	    field :category, :string
48	    field :need_or_want, :string
49	    field :status, :string
50	    field :notes, :string
51	    # Posting-time snapshot of the source document's fingerprint. Only the
52	    # one-off backfill may set it on an existing row (see the backfill module).
53	    field :source_document_sha256, :string, redact: true
54	    field :source_file_reuse_confirmed, :boolean, default: false
55	
56	    belongs_to :review_decision, ReviewDecision
57	    belongs_to :user, User
58	    has_one :tax_deduction_claim, TaxDeductionClaim
59	
60	    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
61	  end
62	
63	  @spec changeset_for_create(map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
64	  def changeset_for_create(attrs) do
65	    %__MODULE__{}
66	    |> cast(attrs, [
67	      :review_decision_id,
68	      :user_id,
69	      :amount_cents,
70	      :currency,
71	      :date,
72	      :description,
73	      :issuer,
74	      :invoice_number,
75	      :status,
76	      :source_document_sha256,
77	      :source_file_reuse_confirmed
78	    ])
79	    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
80	    |> validate_required([:review_decision_id, :user_id, :amount_cents, :currency, :date])
81	    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
82	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:review_decision_id)
83	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
84	    |> unique_constraint(:review_decision_id)
85	    |> fingerprint_constraints()
86	    |> unique_constraint(:invoice_number,
87	      name: @duplicate_invoice_index,
88	      message: "has already been recorded for this issuer"
89	    )
90	  end
91	
92	  @doc """
93	  Changeset for the historical fingerprint backfill: the only permitted update
94	  of `source_document_sha256` (and, for a human-resolved collision,
95	  `source_file_reuse_confirmed`) on an existing entry.
96	  """
97	  @spec changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
98	  def changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
99	    entry
100	    |> cast(attrs, [:source_document_sha256, :source_file_reuse_confirmed])
101	    |> validate_required([:source_document_sha256])
102	    |> fingerprint_constraints()
103	  end
104	
105	  defp fingerprint_constraints(changeset) do
106	    changeset
107	    |> validate_format(:source_document_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
108	    |> unique_constraint(:source_document_sha256,
109	      name: @duplicate_source_file_index,
110	      message: "the same file has already been recorded"
111	    )
112	  end
113	
114	  @doc "Name of the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index."
115	  @spec duplicate_invoice_index() :: String.t()
116	  def duplicate_invoice_index, do: @duplicate_invoice_index
117	
118	  @doc "Name of the unique (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings."
119	  @spec duplicate_source_file_index() :: String.t()
120	  def duplicate_source_file_index, do: @duplicate_source_file_index
121	
122	  @spec changeset_for_categorize(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
123	  def changeset_for_categorize(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
124	    entry
125	    |> cast(attrs, [:category, :need_or_want, :notes, :status])
126	    |> validate_required([:category, :need_or_want])
127	    |> validate_inclusion(:need_or_want, @need_or_want_values)
128	    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
129	    |> check_constraint(:need_or_want, name: :journal_entries_need_or_want_check)
130	  end
131	
132	  @spec need_or_want_values() :: [String.t()]
133	  def need_or_want_values, do: @need_or_want_values
134	end
135

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim do
2	  use Ecto.Schema
3	  import Ecto.Changeset
4	
5	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
6	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
7	
8	  @statuses ["undecided", "candidate", "not_deductible", "claimed", "disallowed"]
9	
10	  @typedoc "Tax deduction claim schema struct"
11	  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
12	          __meta__: Ecto.Schema.Metadata.t(),
13	          id: integer() | nil,
14	          tax_year: integer() | nil,
15	          status: String.t() | nil,
16	          category: String.t() | nil,
17	          deductible_amount_cents: integer() | nil,
18	          notes: String.t() | nil,
19	          journal_entry_id: integer() | nil,
20	          user_id: integer() | nil,
21	          journal_entry: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(JournalEntry.t()),
22	          user: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
23	          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
24	          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
25	        }
26	
27	  schema "tax_deduction_claims" do
28	    field :tax_year, :integer
29	    field :status, :string, default: "undecided"
30	    field :category, :string
31	    field :deductible_amount_cents, :integer
32	    field :notes, :string
33	
34	    belongs_to :journal_entry, JournalEntry
35	    belongs_to :user, User
36	
37	    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
38	  end
39	
40	  @typep persisted_journal_entry :: %JournalEntry{
41	           id: integer(),
42	           amount_cents: integer(),
43	           date: Date.t(),
44	           user_id: integer()
45	         }
46	
47	  @spec changeset_for_create(persisted_journal_entry(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
48	  def changeset_for_create(%JournalEntry{} = entry, attrs) do
49	    %__MODULE__{
50	      journal_entry_id: entry.id,
51	      user_id: entry.user_id,
52	      tax_year: entry.date.year,
53	      deductible_amount_cents: entry.amount_cents
54	    }
55	    |> cast(attrs, [:status, :category, :deductible_amount_cents, :notes])
56	    |> validate_required([
57	      :journal_entry_id,
58	      :user_id,
59	      :tax_year,
60	      :status,
61	      :deductible_amount_cents
62	    ])
63	    |> validate_inclusion(:status, @statuses)
64	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:journal_entry_id)
65	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
66	    |> unique_constraint(:journal_entry_id)
67	    |> check_constraint(:status, name: :tax_deduction_claims_status_check)
68	  end

6	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
7

11	    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
12	    # backfill reads them. Redacted so it never reaches logs.
13	    field :content_sha256, :string, redact: true
14	    field :user_id, :id
15

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent do
2	  use Ecto.Schema
3	  import Ecto.Changeset
4	
5	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
6	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
7	
8	  schema "extracted_content" do
9	    embeds_one :extracted_data, ExtractedData
10	    field :raw_llm_response, :map
11	    field :status, :string
12	    field :error_details, :map
13	    field :analysis, :map
14	    field :trace_id, :string
15	
16	    belongs_to :document, Document
17	    belongs_to :user, ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
18	    has_one :review_decision, ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
19	
20	    timestamps()
21	  end
22	
23	  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}
24	
25	  def changeset(extracted_content, attrs) do
26	    extracted_content
27	    |> cast(attrs, [
28	      :document_id,
29	      :user_id,
30	      :status,
31	      :raw_llm_response,
32	      :error_details,
33	      :analysis,
34	      :trace_id
35	    ])
36	    |> validate_required([:document_id, :status])
37	    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["success", "failed"])
38	    |> maybe_cast_extracted_data(attrs)
39	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:document_id)
40	    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
41	  end
42	
43	  defp maybe_cast_extracted_data(changeset, attrs) do
44	    case status_from_attrs(attrs) do
45	      "failed" ->
46	        put_embed(changeset, :extracted_data, %ExtractedData{})
47	
48	      _ ->
49	        changeset
50	        |> cast_embed(:extracted_data, with: &ExtractedData.embedded_changeset/2)
51	        |> validate_embedded_data_size()
52	        |> validate_extracted_data_for_status()
53	    end
54	  end
55	
56	  defp status_from_attrs(attrs), do: Map.get(attrs, :status) || Map.get(attrs, "status")
57	
58	  defp validate_extracted_data_for_status(changeset) do
59	    status = get_field(changeset, :status)
60	    extracted_data = get_field(changeset, :extracted_data)
61	
62	    case {status, extracted_data} do
63	      # If it failed, we don't care about the data
64	      {"failed", _} ->
65	        changeset
66	
67	      # If it didn't fail, but the data is nil or an empty map, add an error
68	      {_, empty_data} when empty_data in [nil, %{}] ->
69	        add_error(changeset, :extracted_data, "is required for successful extractions")
70	
71	      _ ->
72	        changeset
73	    end
74	  end
75	
76	  defp validate_embedded_data_size(changeset) do
77	    extracted_data = get_field(changeset, :extracted_data)
78	
79	    case extracted_data do
80	      nil ->
81	        changeset
82	
83	      %ExtractedData{} = data ->
84	        size = byte_size(Jason.encode!(Map.from_struct(data)))
85	
86	        if size <= 10_000_000 do
87	          changeset
88	        else
89	          add_error(changeset, :extracted_data, "exceeds maximum size of 10MB")
90	        end
91	    end
92	  end
93	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData do
2	  use Ecto.Schema
3	  import Ecto.Changeset
4	
5	  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency
6	
7	  @primary_key false
8	  embedded_schema do
9	    field(:amount_to_pay_cents, :integer)
10	    field(:invoice_date, :string)
11	    field(:invoice_number, :string)
12	    field(:currency, :string)
13	    field(:reason_for_payment, :string)
14	    field(:issuer, :string)
15	  end
16	
17	  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}
18	
19	  @required_fields [:amount_to_pay_cents, :invoice_date, :currency, :reason_for_payment, :issuer]
20	  @optional_fields [:invoice_number]
21	
22	  def changeset(attrs) when is_map(attrs) do
23	    %__MODULE__{}
24	    |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
25	    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
26	    |> validate_required(@required_fields)
27	  end
28	
29	  def embedded_changeset(_struct, attrs) do
30	    if is_struct(attrs, __MODULE__) do
31	      Ecto.Changeset.change(attrs)
32	    else
33	      %__MODULE__{}
34	      |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
35	      |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
36	      |> validate_required(@required_fields)
37	    end
38	  end
39	
40	  def fields, do: @required_fields ++ @optional_fields
41	
42	  @doc """
43	  Lists the fields whose value differs between `from` and `to` as
44	  `{field, from_value, to_value}`, in `fields/0` order. Surrounding whitespace
45	  is not a difference.
46	  """
47	  @spec changes(t(), t()) :: [{atom(), term(), term()}]
48	  def changes(%__MODULE__{} = from, %__MODULE__{} = to) do
49	    for field <- fields(),
50	        comparable(Map.get(from, field)) != comparable(Map.get(to, field)),
51	        do: {field, Map.get(from, field), Map.get(to, field)}
52	  end
53	
54	  defp comparable(value) when is_binary(value), do: String.trim(value)
55	  defp comparable(value), do: value
56	end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeVerification.Worker do
  @moduledoc """
  Durable TypeSafe shadow verification for one extracted-content row.

  Args are a self-contained command: `extracted_content_id`, `currency_hint`
  and an optional W3C `traceparent` string (nil when tracing is disabled). The
  job never receives OCR markdown or extracted data: markdown is re-derived
  from the row's `raw_llm_response` (`DocumentOCR.extract_markdown/1`) and
  extracted data comes from the row itself.

  Shadow verification is fail-open: provider and persistence failures are
  recorded as a `verification_failed` shadow and the job completes. Oban
  attempts only matter for crashes and Lifeline rescues.
  """
  use Oban.Worker, queue: :typesafe, max_attempts: 3

  require Logger

  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.DocumentOCR
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
  alias ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeClient

  @impl Oban.Worker
  def perform(%Oban.Job{
        args: %{"extracted_content_id" => extraction_id, "currency_hint" => currency_hint} = args
      }) do
    with_trace_parent(Map.get(args, "traceparent"), fn ->
      case ExtractedContentContext.get_by_id(extraction_id) do
        nil -> {:cancel, :extracted_content_deleted}
        content -> verify_content(content, currency_hint)
      end
    end)
  end

  defp with_trace_parent(nil, fun), do: fun.()

  defp with_trace_parent(traceparent, fun) when is_binary(traceparent) do
    token = :otel_propagator_text_map.extract([{"traceparent", traceparent}])

    try do
      fun.()
    after
      OpenTelemetry.Ctx.detach(token)
    end
  end

  defp verify_content(content, currency_hint) do
    case DocumentOCR.extract_markdown(content.raw_llm_response) do
      {:ok, markdown, _raw} ->
        Logger.info("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification started")

        result =
          Langfuse.trace_span("typesafe-shadow-verification", span_attributes(), fn ->
            safely_verify(markdown, content.extracted_data, currency_hint)
          end)

        persist_result(content.id, result)

      {:error, :unexpected_api_structure} ->
        persist_result(content.id, {:error, :markdown_unavailable})
    end
  end

  defp safely_verify(markdown, extracted_data, currency_hint) do
    TypeSafeClient.verify_extraction(markdown, extracted_data, currency_hint)
  rescue
    exception ->
      record_unexpected_failure({:exception, exception.__struct__}, __STACKTRACE__)
  catch
    kind, _reason when kind in [:exit, :throw] ->
      record_unexpected_failure(kind, __STACKTRACE__)
  end

  defp record_unexpected_failure(reason, stacktrace) do
    error = error_class(reason)
    sanitized_stacktrace = sanitize_stacktrace(stacktrace)

    Logger.error(
      "[TypeSafe] Shadow verification crashed class=#{error}\n#{sanitized_stacktrace}",
      typesafe_error_class: error,
      typesafe_stacktrace: sanitized_stacktrace
    )

    {:error, reason}
  end

  defp sanitize_stacktrace(stacktrace) do
    stacktrace
    |> Enum.map(fn {module, function, args_or_arity, location} ->
      arity = if is_list(args_or_arity), do: length(args_or_arity), else: args_or_arity
      {module, function, arity, Keyword.take(location, [:file, :line])}
    end)
    |> Exception.format_stacktrace()
  end

  defp persist_result(extraction_id, {:ok, shadow}) do
    case ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) do
      {:ok, _content} ->
        Logger.info("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification succeeded #{log_metadata(shadow)}",
          typesafe_status: shadow["status"],
          typesafe_model: shadow["model"]
        )

        :ok

      {:error, reason} ->
        error = error_class(reason)

        Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification persistence failed class=#{error}",
          typesafe_error_class: error
        )

        :ok
    end
  end

  defp persist_result(_extraction_id, :disabled), do: :ok

  defp persist_result(extraction_id, {:error, reason}) do
    error = error_class(reason)

    Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification failed class=#{error}",
      typesafe_error_class: error
    )

    shadow = %{
      "status" => "verification_failed",
      "error" => error
    }

    case ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) do
      {:ok, _content} ->
        :ok

      {:error, persistence_reason} ->
        persistence_error = error_class(persistence_reason)

        Logger.warning(
          "[TypeSafe] Shadow verification persistence failed class=#{persistence_error}",
          typesafe_error_class: persistence_error
        )

        :ok
    end
  end

  defp log_metadata(shadow) do
    [
      "status=#{shadow["status"]}",
      "model=#{shadow["model"]}",
      "max_error_probability=#{shadow["max_error_probability"]}",
      "review_threshold=#{shadow["review_threshold"]}"
    ]
    |> Enum.join(" ")
  end

  defp error_class({:http, status}) when is_integer(status), do: "http_#{status}"
  defp error_class(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: Atom.to_string(reason)
  defp error_class({kind, reason}) when is_atom(kind) and is_atom(reason), do: "#{kind}:#{reason}"
  defp error_class(_reason), do: "unknown"

  defp span_attributes do
    config = Application.get_env(:zaimu_tomo, :typesafe, [])

    %{
      "langfuse.observation.model.name" => Keyword.get(config, :model, "jev-latest"),
      "gen_ai.request.model" => Keyword.get(config, :model, "jev-latest")
    }
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Application do
  # See https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/Application.html
  # for more information on OTP Applications
  @moduledoc false

  use Application

  @impl true
  def start(_type, _args) do
    ZaimuTomo.Langfuse.setup()
    ZaimuTomo.ObanFailureLogger.attach()

    children =
      [
        ZaimuTomoWeb.Telemetry,
        ZaimuTomo.Repo,
        {DNSCluster, query: Application.get_env(:zaimu_tomo, :dns_cluster_query) || :ignore},
        {Phoenix.PubSub, name: ZaimuTomo.PubSub},
        # Durable job queue. Placed after PubSub so job broadcasts can reach
        # connected LiveViews, and before the Endpoint that enqueues on upload.
        {Oban, Application.fetch_env!(:zaimu_tomo, Oban)},
        # Start a worker by calling: ZaimuTomo.Worker.start_link(arg)
        # {ZaimuTomo.Worker, arg},
        # Start to serve requests, typically the last entry
        ZaimuTomoWeb.Endpoint
      ] ++ storage_children()

    # See https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/Supervisor.html
    # for other strategies and supported options
    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: ZaimuTomo.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end

  # Tell Phoenix to update the endpoint configuration
  # whenever the application is updated.
  @impl true
  def config_change(changed, _new, removed) do
    ZaimuTomoWeb.Endpoint.config_change(changed, removed)
    :ok
  end

  defp storage_children do
    case Application.fetch_env!(:zaimu_tomo, :storage) |> Keyword.fetch!(:adapter) do
      ZaimuTomo.Storage.Memory -> [ZaimuTomo.Storage.Memory]
      _adapter -> []
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Storage.Migration do
  @moduledoc """
  Copies legacy document files into the configured object store without changing
  the document records that already reference their portable object keys.
  """

  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents
  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage

  @type missing_source :: %{object_key: String.t(), path: Path.t()}
  @type failure :: %{object_key: String.t(), operation: atom(), reason: term()}

  @type summary :: %{
          uploaded: non_neg_integer(),
          skipped_existing: non_neg_integer(),
          missing_sources: [missing_source()],
          failures: [failure()]
        }

  @spec migrate(Path.t()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def migrate(source_dir) when is_binary(source_dir) do
    summary =
      Documents.list_document_object_keys()
      |> Enum.reduce(empty_summary(), &migrate_object(&1, source_dir, &2))
      |> finalize_summary()

    result(summary)
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    [
      "Storage migration summary: uploaded=#{summary.uploaded} " <>
        "skipped-existing=#{summary.skipped_existing} " <>
        "missing-source=#{length(summary.missing_sources)} failed=#{length(summary.failures)}"
      | Enum.map(summary.missing_sources, &format_missing_source/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.failures, &format_failure/1)
    ]
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  defp migrate_object(object_key, source_dir, summary) do
    case Storage.head_object(object_key) do
      :ok ->
        %{summary | skipped_existing: summary.skipped_existing + 1}

      {:error, :not_found} ->
        upload_missing_object(object_key, source_dir, summary)

      {:error, reason} ->
        add_failure(summary, object_key, :head, reason)
    end
  end

  defp upload_missing_object(object_key, source_dir, summary) do
    source_path = Path.join(source_dir, Path.basename(object_key))

    case File.read(source_path) do
      {:ok, body} ->
        case Storage.put_object(object_key, body) do
          {:ok, ^object_key} ->
            %{summary | uploaded: summary.uploaded + 1}

          {:ok, returned_key} ->
            add_failure(summary, object_key, :put, {:unexpected_key, returned_key})

          {:error, reason} ->
            add_failure(summary, object_key, :put, reason)
        end

      {:error, :enoent} ->
        %{
          summary
          | missing_sources: [
              %{object_key: object_key, path: source_path} | summary.missing_sources
            ]
        }

      {:error, reason} ->
        add_failure(summary, object_key, :read_source, reason)
    end
  end

  defp empty_summary do
    %{uploaded: 0, skipped_existing: 0, missing_sources: [], failures: []}
  end

  defp add_failure(summary, object_key, operation, reason) do
    %{
      summary
      | failures: [
          %{object_key: object_key, operation: operation, reason: reason} | summary.failures
        ]
    }
  end

  defp result(%{missing_sources: [], failures: []} = summary), do: {:ok, summary}
  defp result(summary), do: {:error, summary}

  defp finalize_summary(summary) do
    %{
      summary
      | missing_sources: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_sources),
        failures: Enum.reverse(summary.failures)
    }
  end

  defp format_missing_source(%{object_key: object_key, path: path}) do
    "Missing source: #{path} for #{object_key}"
  end

  defp format_failure(%{object_key: object_key, operation: operation, reason: reason}) do
    "Failure: #{operation} for #{object_key}: #{inspect(reason)}"
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.ObanFailureLogger do
  @moduledoc """
  Logs failed Oban job attempts (an `{:error, reason}` return, a raise or a
  crash), which Oban otherwise only records in `oban_jobs.errors`.

  Log lines stay body-free: a returned reason is logged only when it is a
  string (the workers return bounded summaries such as
  `ErrorClassification.summarize/1`), and a raise is logged by exception module
  and failing frame, never by message or arguments.
  """

  require Logger

  @handler_id "zaimu-tomo-oban-failure-logger"

  @doc """
  Attaches the `[:oban, :job, :exception]` handler. Safe to call repeatedly.
  """
  def attach do
    case :telemetry.attach(
           @handler_id,
           [:oban, :job, :exception],
           &__MODULE__.handle_event/4,
           nil
         ) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, :already_exists} -> :ok
    end
  end

  @doc false
  def handle_event([:oban, :job, :exception], _measurements, meta, _config) do
    %{job: job, state: state, kind: kind, reason: reason, stacktrace: stacktrace} = meta

    Logger.warning(
      "[Oban] #{job.worker} job #{job.id} attempt #{job.attempt}/#{job.max_attempts} " <>
        "failed (#{state}): #{describe(kind, reason, stacktrace)}"
    )
  end

  defp describe(:error, %Oban.PerformError{reason: {:error, summary}}, _stacktrace)
       when is_binary(summary),
       do: summary

  defp describe(:error, %Oban.PerformError{}, _stacktrace), do: "error return"

  defp describe(:error, %module{}, stacktrace), do: "#{inspect(module)}#{location(stacktrace)}"

  defp describe(kind, _reason, stacktrace), do: "#{kind}#{location(stacktrace)}"

  defp location([{module, function, args_or_arity, location} | _rest]) do
    arity = if is_list(args_or_arity), do: length(args_or_arity), else: args_or_arity
    " at " <> Exception.format_stacktrace_entry({module, function, arity, location})
  end

  defp location(_stacktrace), do: ""
end

94	```

96	Notes:

4. In the RustFS console (reached through an SSH tunnel, never published), create the bucket named by `S3_BUCKET` **with versioning and Object Lock enabled**. Object Lock cannot be added after creation.
5. Check the app over the VPN, and run `kamal verify_storage`.

## Routine deploy

```sh
set -a; source .kamal/secrets; set +a
kamal deploy
kamal migrate        # when the release contains migrations
```

Notes:

- Kamal performs a zero-downtime switch at the proxy. In-flight Oban jobs on the old container are rescued by `Oban.Lifeline` after 30 minutes, if they don't finish during shutdown.
- Migrations run *after* the new container is live, so write migrations that the previous release can run against (additive first, destructive later).
- Kamal aliases (`config/deploy.yml` → `aliases`) are invoked directly: `kamal console`, `kamal migrate`, `kamal db_rollback`, `kamal verify_storage`, `kamal recover_stuck_documents`, `kamal backfill_document_fingerprints`, `kamal migrate_to_s3`.

## CI

GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs on pushes to `main` and on every
PR, for any base branch so stacked PRs are covered, as three jobs: `lint` (format
check, blocking `mix credo --strict`, unused-dependency check), `test` (compiles
with warnings as errors, migrates a Postgres 18 service, runs `mix test`), and `security-audit`
(`mix hex.audit`, advisory/non-blocking — a new CVE in an unrelated dependency
shouldn't block unrelated work). A separate scheduled workflow
(`.github/workflows/nightly-audit.yml`) re-runs `mix hex.audit` nightly, since
that's the only way to catch a CVE disclosed on a day with no pushes at all. CI
does **not** deploy. Deploys are manual with Kamal from the operator's machine.
Dependabot opens grouped dependency bumps.

A separate scheduled workflow (`.github/workflows/nightly-dialyzer.yml`) runs
`mix dialyzer` nightly, with its PLTs cached under `priv/plts` (keyed on
`mix.lock`, rebuilt only when dependencies change). Advisory, not a required
check: Dialyzer's whole-program success typing is a complementary, slower
check that doesn't gate pushes. Known tool/stdlib false positives are
suppressed in `.dialyzer_ignore.exs`, each with a comment explaining why it's
benign — re-verify them after any Ecto, Elixir, or OTP upgrade.

All jobs in all three workflows pin `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` rather than
`ubuntu-latest`, so a GitHub image migration can't silently change the toolchain
under a green build. Bump the label deliberately, in one commit, when a newer
image is worth adopting.

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeVerification.Worker do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Durable TypeSafe shadow verification for one extracted-content row.
4	
5	  Args are a self-contained command: `extracted_content_id`, `currency_hint`
6	  and an optional W3C `traceparent` string (nil when tracing is disabled). The
7	  job never receives OCR markdown or extracted data: markdown is re-derived
8	  from the row's `raw_llm_response` (`DocumentOCR.extract_markdown/1`) and
9	  extracted data comes from the row itself.
10	
11	  Shadow verification is fail-open: provider and persistence failures are
12	  recorded as a `verification_failed` shadow and the job completes. Oban
13	  attempts only matter for crashes and Lifeline rescues.
14	  """
15	  use Oban.Worker, queue: :typesafe, max_attempts: 3
16	
17	  require Logger
18	
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.DocumentOCR
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
21	  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
22	  alias ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeClient
23	
24	  @impl Oban.Worker
25	  def perform(%Oban.Job{
26	        args: %{"extracted_content_id" => extraction_id, "currency_hint" => currency_hint} = args
27	      }) do
28	    with_trace_parent(Map.get(args, "traceparent"), fn ->
29	      case ExtractedContentContext.get_by_id(extraction_id) do
30	        nil -> {:cancel, :extracted_content_deleted}
31	        content -> verify_content(content, currency_hint)
32	      end
33	    end)
34	  end
35	
36	  defp with_trace_parent(nil, fun), do: fun.()
37	
38	  defp with_trace_parent(traceparent, fun) when is_binary(traceparent) do
39	    token = :otel_propagator_text_map.extract([{"traceparent", traceparent}])
40	
41	    try do
42	      fun.()
43	    after
44	      OpenTelemetry.Ctx.detach(token)
45	    end
46	  end
47	
48	  defp verify_content(content, currency_hint) do
49	    case DocumentOCR.extract_markdown(content.raw_llm_response) do
50	      {:ok, markdown, _raw} ->
51	        Logger.info("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification started")
52	
53	        result =
54	          Langfuse.trace_span("typesafe-shadow-verification", span_attributes(), fn ->
55	            safely_verify(markdown, content.extracted_data, currency_hint)
56	          end)
57	
58	        persist_result(content.id, result)
59	
60	      {:error, :unexpected_api_structure} ->
61	        persist_result(content.id, {:error, :markdown_unavailable})
62	    end
63	  end
64	
65	  defp safely_verify(markdown, extracted_data, currency_hint) do
66	    TypeSafeClient.verify_extraction(markdown, extracted_data, currency_hint)
67	  rescue
68	    exception ->
69	      record_unexpected_failure({:exception, exception.__struct__}, __STACKTRACE__)
70	  catch
71	    kind, _reason when kind in [:exit, :throw] ->
72	      record_unexpected_failure(kind, __STACKTRACE__)
73	  end
74	
75	  defp record_unexpected_failure(reason, stacktrace) do
76	    error = error_class(reason)
77	    sanitized_stacktrace = sanitize_stacktrace(stacktrace)
78	
79	    Logger.error(
80	      "[TypeSafe] Shadow verification crashed class=#{error}\n#{sanitized_stacktrace}",
81	      typesafe_error_class: error,
82	      typesafe_stacktrace: sanitized_stacktrace
83	    )
84	
85	    {:error, reason}
86	  end
87	
88	  defp sanitize_stacktrace(stacktrace) do
89	    stacktrace
90	    |> Enum.map(fn {module, function, args_or_arity, location} ->
91	      arity = if is_list(args_or_arity), do: length(args_or_arity), else: args_or_arity
92	      {module, function, arity, Keyword.take(location, [:file, :line])}
93	    end)
94	    |> Exception.format_stacktrace()
95	  end
96	
97	  defp persist_result(extraction_id, {:ok, shadow}) do
98	    case ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) do
99	      {:ok, _content} ->
100	        Logger.info("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification succeeded #{log_metadata(shadow)}",
101	          typesafe_status: shadow["status"],
102	          typesafe_model: shadow["model"]
103	        )
104	
105	        :ok
106	
107	      {:error, reason} ->
108	        error = error_class(reason)
109	
110	        Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification persistence failed class=#{error}",
111	          typesafe_error_class: error
112	        )
113	
114	        :ok
115	    end
116	  end
117	
118	  defp persist_result(_extraction_id, :disabled), do: :ok
119	
120	  defp persist_result(extraction_id, {:error, reason}) do
121	    error = error_class(reason)
122	
123	    Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification failed class=#{error}",
124	      typesafe_error_class: error
125	    )
126	
127	    shadow = %{
128	      "status" => "verification_failed",
129	      "error" => error
130	    }
131	
132	    case ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) do
133	      {:ok, _content} ->
134	        :ok
135	
136	      {:error, persistence_reason} ->
137	        persistence_error = error_class(persistence_reason)
138	
139	        Logger.warning(
140	          "[TypeSafe] Shadow verification persistence failed class=#{persistence_error}",
141	          typesafe_error_class: persistence_error
142	        )
143	
144	        :ok
145	    end
146	  end
147	
148	  defp log_metadata(shadow) do
149	    [
150	      "status=#{shadow["status"]}",
151	      "model=#{shadow["model"]}",
152	      "max_error_probability=#{shadow["max_error_probability"]}",
153	      "review_threshold=#{shadow["review_threshold"]}"
154	    ]
155	    |> Enum.join(" ")
156	  end
157	
158	  defp error_class({:http, status}) when is_integer(status), do: "http_#{status}"
159	  defp error_class(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: Atom.to_string(reason)
160	  defp error_class({kind, reason}) when is_atom(kind) and is_atom(reason), do: "#{kind}:#{reason}"
161	  defp error_class(_reason), do: "unknown"
162	
163	  defp span_attributes do
164	    config = Application.get_env(:zaimu_tomo, :typesafe, [])
165	
166	    %{
167	      "langfuse.observation.model.name" => Keyword.get(config, :model, "jev-latest"),
168	      "gen_ai.request.model" => Keyword.get(config, :model, "jev-latest")
169	    }
170	  end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Storage.Migration do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Copies legacy document files into the configured object store without changing
4	  the document records that already reference their portable object keys.
5	  """
6	
7	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents
8	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
9	
10	  @type missing_source :: %{object_key: String.t(), path: Path.t()}
11	  @type failure :: %{object_key: String.t(), operation: atom(), reason: term()}
12	
13	  @type summary :: %{
14	          uploaded: non_neg_integer(),
15	          skipped_existing: non_neg_integer(),
16	          missing_sources: [missing_source()],
17	          failures: [failure()]
18	        }
19	
20	  @spec migrate(Path.t()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
21	  def migrate(source_dir) when is_binary(source_dir) do
22	    summary =
23	      Documents.list_document_object_keys()
24	      |> Enum.reduce(empty_summary(), &migrate_object(&1, source_dir, &2))
25	      |> finalize_summary()
26	
27	    result(summary)
28	  end
29	
30	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
31	  def format_summary(summary) do
32	    [
33	      "Storage migration summary: uploaded=#{summary.uploaded} " <>
34	        "skipped-existing=#{summary.skipped_existing} " <>
35	        "missing-source=#{length(summary.missing_sources)} failed=#{length(summary.failures)}"
36	      | Enum.map(summary.missing_sources, &format_missing_source/1) ++
37	          Enum.map(summary.failures, &format_failure/1)
38	    ]
39	    |> Enum.join("\n")
40	  end
41	
42	  defp migrate_object(object_key, source_dir, summary) do
43	    case Storage.head_object(object_key) do
44	      :ok ->
45	        %{summary | skipped_existing: summary.skipped_existing + 1}
46	
47	      {:error, :not_found} ->
48	        upload_missing_object(object_key, source_dir, summary)
49	
50	      {:error, reason} ->
51	        add_failure(summary, object_key, :head, reason)
52	    end
53	  end
54	
55	  defp upload_missing_object(object_key, source_dir, summary) do
56	    source_path = Path.join(source_dir, Path.basename(object_key))
57	
58	    case File.read(source_path) do
59	      {:ok, body} ->
60	        case Storage.put_object(object_key, body) do
61	          {:ok, ^object_key} ->
62	            %{summary | uploaded: summary.uploaded + 1}
63	
64	          {:ok, returned_key} ->
65	            add_failure(summary, object_key, :put, {:unexpected_key, returned_key})
66	
67	          {:error, reason} ->
68	            add_failure(summary, object_key, :put, reason)
69	        end
70	
71	      {:error, :enoent} ->
72	        %{
73	          summary
74	          | missing_sources: [
75	              %{object_key: object_key, path: source_path} | summary.missing_sources
76	            ]
77	        }
78	
79	      {:error, reason} ->
80	        add_failure(summary, object_key, :read_source, reason)
81	    end
82	  end
83	
84	  defp empty_summary do
85	    %{uploaded: 0, skipped_existing: 0, missing_sources: [], failures: []}
86	  end
87	
88	  defp add_failure(summary, object_key, operation, reason) do
89	    %{
90	      summary
91	      | failures: [
92	          %{object_key: object_key, operation: operation, reason: reason} | summary.failures
93	        ]
94	    }
95	  end
96	
97	  defp result(%{missing_sources: [], failures: []} = summary), do: {:ok, summary}
98	  defp result(summary), do: {:error, summary}
99	
100	  defp finalize_summary(summary) do
101	    %{
102	      summary
103	      | missing_sources: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_sources),
104	        failures: Enum.reverse(summary.failures)
105	    }
106	  end
107	
108	  defp format_missing_source(%{object_key: object_key, path: path}) do
109	    "Missing source: #{path} for #{object_key}"
110	  end
111	
112	  defp format_failure(%{object_key: object_key, operation: operation, reason: reason}) do
113	    "Failure: #{operation} for #{object_key}: #{inspect(reason)}"
114	  end
115	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.ObanFailureLogger do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Logs failed Oban job attempts (an `{:error, reason}` return, a raise or a
4	  crash), which Oban otherwise only records in `oban_jobs.errors`.
5	
6	  Log lines stay body-free: a returned reason is logged only when it is a
7	  string (the workers return bounded summaries such as
8	  `ErrorClassification.summarize/1`), and a raise is logged by exception module
9	  and failing frame, never by message or arguments.
10	  """
11	
12	  require Logger
13	
14	  @handler_id "zaimu-tomo-oban-failure-logger"
15	
16	  @doc """
17	  Attaches the `[:oban, :job, :exception]` handler. Safe to call repeatedly.
18	  """
19	  def attach do
20	    case :telemetry.attach(
21	           @handler_id,
22	           [:oban, :job, :exception],
23	           &__MODULE__.handle_event/4,
24	           nil
25	         ) do
26	      :ok -> :ok
27	      {:error, :already_exists} -> :ok
28	    end
29	  end
30	
31	  @doc false
32	  def handle_event([:oban, :job, :exception], _measurements, meta, _config) do
33	    %{job: job, state: state, kind: kind, reason: reason, stacktrace: stacktrace} = meta
34	
35	    Logger.warning(
36	      "[Oban] #{job.worker} job #{job.id} attempt #{job.attempt}/#{job.max_attempts} " <>
37	        "failed (#{state}): #{describe(kind, reason, stacktrace)}"
38	    )
39	  end
40	
41	  defp describe(:error, %Oban.PerformError{reason: {:error, summary}}, _stacktrace)
42	       when is_binary(summary),
43	       do: summary
44	
45	  defp describe(:error, %Oban.PerformError{}, _stacktrace), do: "error return"
46	
47	  defp describe(:error, %module{}, stacktrace), do: "#{inspect(module)}#{location(stacktrace)}"
48	
49	  defp describe(kind, _reason, stacktrace), do: "#{kind}#{location(stacktrace)}"
50	
51	  defp location([{module, function, args_or_arity, location} | _rest]) do
52	    arity = if is_list(args_or_arity), do: length(args_or_arity), else: args_or_arity
53	    " at " <> Exception.format_stacktrace_entry({module, function, arity, location})
54	  end
55	
56	  defp location(_stacktrace), do: ""
57	end
58

1	defmodule Mix.Tasks.ZaimuTomo.BackfillDocumentFingerprints do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Backfills SHA-256 fingerprints for existing documents and their journal
4	  entries. Idempotent and safe to run while the app is online; see
5	  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill`.
6	
7	  Exits non-zero while historical coverage is incomplete (missing or
8	  unreadable objects, or same-user collisions awaiting human review).
9	
10	      mix zaimu_tomo.backfill_document_fingerprints
11	      mix zaimu_tomo.backfill_document_fingerprints --confirm-reuse 123 --confirm-reuse 456
12	
13	  `--confirm-reuse ID` records a human decision that the reported later
14	  journal entry is a legitimate reuse of the same file (for example, a reused
15	  QR-bill); it is applied only to an entry that collides.
16	  """
17	  @shortdoc "Backfills exact-byte document fingerprints"
18	
19	  use Mix.Task
20	
21	  alias ZaimuTomo.Release
22	
23	  @usage "usage: mix zaimu_tomo.backfill_document_fingerprints [--confirm-reuse ID]..."
24	
25	  @impl Mix.Task
26	  def run(args) do
27	    case OptionParser.parse(args, strict: [confirm_reuse: [:integer, :keep]]) do
28	      {opts, [], []} ->
29	        Release.backfill_document_fingerprints!(
30	          confirm_reuse: Keyword.get_values(opts, :confirm_reuse)
31	        )
32	
33	      _ ->
34	        Mix.raise(@usage)
35	    end
36	  end
37	end

create posted journal_entry (source_document_sha256 snapshot) + tax claim + event_log 208:### 6.2 Failure, retry and recovery 235:### 6.3 TypeSafe shadow verification (optional) 248:## 7. 83	   ```
84	
85	4. In the RustFS console (reached through an SSH tunnel, never published), create the bucket named by `S3_BUCKET` **with versioning and Object Lock enabled**. Object Lock cannot be added after creation.
86	5. Check the app over the VPN, and run `kamal verify_storage`.
87	
88	## Routine deploy
89	
90	```sh
91	set -a; source .kamal/secrets; set +a
92	kamal deploy
93	kamal migrate        # when the release contains migrations
94	```
95	
96	Notes:
97	
98	- Kamal performs a zero-downtime switch at the proxy. In-flight Oban jobs on the old container are rescued by `Oban.Lifeline` after 30 minutes, if they don't finish during shutdown.
99	- Migrations run *after* the new container is live, so write migrations that the previous release can run against (additive first, destructive later).
100	- Kamal aliases (`config/deploy.yml` → `aliases`) are invoked directly: `kamal console`, `kamal migrate`, `kamal db_rollback`, `kamal verify_storage`, `kamal recover_stuck_documents`, `kamal backfill_document_fingerprints`, `kamal migrate_to_s3`.
101	
102	## CI
103	
104	GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs on pushes to `main` and on every
105	PR, for any base branch so stacked PRs are covered, as three jobs: `lint` (format
106	check, blocking `mix credo --strict`, unused-dependency check), `test` (compiles
107	with warnings as errors, migrates a Postgres 18 service, runs `mix test`), and `security-audit`
108	(`mix hex.audit`, advisory/non-blocking — a new CVE in an unrelated dependency
109	shouldn't block unrelated work). A separate scheduled workflow
110	(`.github/workflows/nightly-audit.yml`) re-runs `mix hex.audit` nightly, since
111	that's the only way to catch a CVE disclosed on a day with no pushes at all. CI
112	does **not** deploy. Deploys are manual with Kamal from the operator's machine.
113	Dependabot opens grouped dependency bumps.
114	
115	A separate scheduled workflow (`.github/workflows/nightly-dialyzer.yml`) runs
116	`mix dialyzer` nightly, with its PLTs cached under `priv/plts` (keyed on
117	`mix.lock`, rebuilt only when dependencies change). Advisory, not a required
118	check: Dialyzer's whole-program success typing is a complementary, slower
119	check that doesn't gate pushes. Known tool/stdlib false positives are
120	suppressed in `.dialyzer_ignore.exs`, each with a comment explaining why it's
121	benign — re-verify them after any Ecto, Elixir, or OTP upgrade.
122	
123	All jobs in all three workflows pin `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` rather than
124	`ubuntu-latest`, so a GitHub image migration can't silently change the toolchain
125	under a green build. Bump the label deliberately, in one commit, when a newer
126	image is worth adopting.

284	
285	### Data model
286	
287	```mermaid
288	erDiagram
289	    users ||--o{ documents : owns
290	    users ||--o{ financial_accounts : owns

292	    extracted_content ||--|| review_decisions : "one decision"
293	    review_decisions ||--o{ event_logs : "audit trail"

295	    journal_entries ||--o| tax_deduction_claims : ""
296	    financial_accounts ||--o{ balance_snapshots : ""
297	```
298	
299	- `documents` stores `filename` (original name), `object_key` (`documents/<uuid>.<ext>`), and `content_sha256` (SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes, lowercase hex; null for legacy rows until the backfill reads them). The bytes live only in object storage. Replacing the object replaces the digest.
300	- `extracted_content` holds `extracted_data` (an embedded schema), `raw_llm_response`, an `analysis` map (verification and TypeSafe shadow results), `status` (`success` or `failed`), `error_details`, and the Langfuse `trace_id`.
301	- Money is stored in integer cents with an ISO currency code. Each user has a `base_currency` (default CHF), which is snapshotted into each OCR job as the currency hint.
302	- `oban_jobs` lives in the same database. Finished jobs are pruned after 7 days.
303	- Deleting a document that has a posted journal entry is blocked by a foreign key.
304	- A partial unique index on `journal_entries (user_id, lower(btrim(issuer)), lower(btrim(invoice_number)))` blocks posting the same numbered invoice twice per user. An unnumbered invoice matching an existing entry's exact `(issuer, date, amount, currency)` tuple is a soft match that requires explicit reviewer confirmation to post. See `Accounting.duplicate_candidates/2`.
305	- `journal_entries.source_document_sha256` is an immutable posting-time copy of the source document's `content_sha256`; `source_file_reuse_confirmed` (default false) marks a posting the reviewer explicitly confirmed as a reuse of the same file. The partial unique index `journal_entries (user_id, source_document_sha256) WHERE source_document_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT source_file_reuse_confirmed` allows one unconfirmed posting per file per user. `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` ranks matches as same file > invoice number > same details; a file match is confirmable only when no field rule also matches (the tuple is compared against the file-matched entries even for numbered invoices). Confirmations are logged as `source_file_reuse_confirmed` events with the matched entry IDs. Fingerprints are user-scoped, redacted from inspect output, and never rendered or sent to an AI provider. Only `FingerprintBackfill` may set them on existing entries; there is no immutability trigger on `journal_entries` yet, and any future one must run after the backfill or allow it.
306	
307	### Multi-tenancy and authorization
308	
309	Every context function takes `%Accounts.Scope{}` first and filters by
310	`scope.user.id`. Routes requiring login live in `live_session :require_authenticated_user`.
311	Unscoped functions exist only for maintenance tasks (storage verification,
312	stuck recovery, fingerprint backfill) and say so in their docs.
